name: Adonis Minerals Corp.
description: Junior mineral exploration company focused on acquisition and exploration of mineral properties in British Columbia. Incorporated 2023, listed CSE March 12, 2025.

name: Adelphi Metals Inc.
description: Junior mineral exploration company. Flagship Triple R gold project in BC. Optioned Brady Sudbury Project in Ontario March 2026. Listed CSE November 2024.

name: Affinity Metals Corp.
description: Junior exploration company focused on silver-lead-zinc and gold. Flagship Regal Project in BC Kootenay Arc (100% owned). Windfall North gold property in Quebec Abitibi Belt. Discovery Lake gold option in NW Ontario. Formerly Acme Resources Inc. Listed CSE.

name: Arctic Fox Lithium Corp.
description: Canadian junior mineral exploration company focused on lithium, copper, and more recently rare earth element and niobium opportunities.

name: Avanti Gold Corp.
description: Gold exploration and development company. Flagship Misisi Gold Project in DRC (3.11 Moz Inferred at Akyanga). Kraaipan Gold Project in South Africa acquired Jun 2024. Formerly Valorem Resources. Listed CSE.

name: Alaros Exploration Inc.
description: Junior mineral exploration company. Principal asset is the Birk Creek Property in Kamloops Mining Division, BC. VMS copper-gold-silver target. Listed CSE January 2026.

name: Alma Gold Inc.
description: Junior gold exploration company. Properties in Guinea (Karita, Dialakoro) and New Brunswick (Clarence Stream North). Incorporated 2020, listed CSE Oct 2021. Grassroots stage - no drilling completed.

name: Abitibi Metals Corp.
description: Base and precious metals exploration company. Flagship B26 VMS deposit (25+ Mt @ 2.1-2.2% CuEq) in QC with 80% interest. Also Beschefer Gold (100%), Horizon (ON), Bonanza, Southern Arm, Val DOr North, Quevillon West (QC). Formerly Goldseek Resources. Listed CSE.

name: Anteros Metals Inc.
description: Junior mineral exploration company using data science/AI to target mineral deposits. Four 100% owned NL properties (Knob Lake Fe-Mn, Havens Steady VMS, Strickland VMS, Hopedale Ni-Cu-Co) plus Seagull JV (PGE-Ni-Cu, Ontario, option up to 49%). Listed CSE Jan 2025.

name: Appia Rare Earths & Uranium Corp.
description: Critical minerals exploration

name: Apex Critical Metals Corp.
description: Junior exploration company focused on critical minerals. Flagship CAP Project (Nb-REE, BC, 100%) and Rift Rare Earth Project (REE-Nb, Nebraska, 100% controlled). Also holds Bianco (Nb-REE, ON, 100%), Lac Le Moyne (Nb-REE, QC, 100%), and West James Bay lithium portfolio (~10% retained + 1% royalty). Listed CSE.

name: Argyle Resources Corp.
description: Junior exploration company focused on rare earth elements, graphite, and high-purity silica. Eight properties across Canada (NS, QC, ON) and USA (WY, ID). Also trades OTCQB: ARLYF, FSE: ME0. Listed CSE May 2024.

name: Armory Mining Corp.
description: Junior exploration company focused on lithium, antimony and gold. Three properties: Candela II lithium brine (Argentina, 80%), Riley Creek antimony-gold (BC, 100% + option), Ammo antimony-gold (NS, option to 100%). Formerly Spey Resources Corp. Listed CSE.

name: Argo Gold Inc.
description: Argo Gold Inc. is a Canadian mineral exploration and development company incorporated in 1995 and based in Toronto, Ontario. Its core assets are high-grade gold projects in northwestern Ontario (Uchi Gold Project and Talbot Lake Gold Project), uranium claims in the Athabasca Basin, gold and silver properties in the Rottenstone Metallogenic Belt in Saskatchewan, and producing oil wells in the Lloydminster area of Alberta. The company was formerly known as Arbitrage Exploration Inc. and changed its name to Argo Gold Inc. in September 2016. Eric Sprott is the largest shareholder with approximately a 19% interest. Institutions and insiders collectively own approximately 50% of shares outstanding.

name: Ares Strategic Mining Inc.
description: Fluorspar producer with flagship Lost Sheep Mine (Utah, 100%) in production ramp-up since Feb 2026. Also owns Delta Processing Site (lumps & flotation plants, Utah) and 5 Ontario quarry parcels. Listed CSE.

name: Ashley Gold Corp.
description: Gold exploration company in Ontario and BC/Yukon. Flagship Burnthut property near Sioux Lookout. Also holds Howie Lake, Alto-Gardnar, Santa Maria (Ontario) and Icefield portfolio (Gold Mountain BC, Vertebrae Ridge YT). Listed CSE.

name: ATERRA Metals Inc.
description: Cu-Au exploration company focused on Region III Chile. Formerly Cascada Silver Corp (name change Dec 2025). Totora Project (Frontera, Taruca, Clinton, Sevilla, Algarrobilla) and standalone Angie Cu/Mo and Mina Guanaca Cu projects. Listed CSE.

name: Athena Gold Corporation
description: Gold exploration company with assets in Nevada and Ontario. Flagship Excelsior Springs Au-Ag project (20% free-carried JV with Mammoth Minerals). Laird Lake Au in Red Lake district (option to 100%). Oneman Lake Au-Zn-Cu 100% owned. Listed CSE.

name: Antimony Resources Corp.
description: Antimony exploration company focused on Bald Hill Antimony project in New Brunswick, Canada. Formerly Big Red Mining Corp (name change Mar 2025). Option to earn 100% from Globex Mining. Listed CSE.

name: Auxico Resources Canada Inc.
description: Critical minerals explorer focused on REE, Nb, Ta, PGM, Li in Colombia and Bolivia. Flagship Minastyc project (Vichada, Colombia) with NI 43-101. El Benton Nb-Ta-Li mine (Bolivia, 85%). Licensed Ultrasound Assisted Extraction (UAEx) technology. Also OTCQB: AUXIF. Listed CSE.

name: Inflection Resources Ltd
description: Cu-Au porphyry explorer in NSW and NT Australia. Flagship Trangie project (Macquarie Arc). AngloGold Ashanti Phase II earn-in partner on 4 projects. Acquired Bell River and Endurance (Tennant East) from Newmont Jun 2025. Also OTCQB: AUCUF, FSE: 5VJ. Listed CSE.

name: Advanced Gold Exploration Inc.
description: Au and Cu-Zn-Ag VMS explorer in Ontario Canada. Flagship Doyle Property (Hemlo look-alike, visible gold Oct 2024, 3000m drill permit 2026). Buck Lake VMS Cu-Zn project with 4.59% Cu/3.2m highlight. Paint Lake Road JV with Frontline Gold. Formerly Advance United Holdings. Also OTCQB: AUHID.

name: Auric Minerals Corp.
description: Uranium and critical minerals explorer focused on Labrador Central Mineral Belt (NL) and Quebec. Acquired Central Uranium Resources (Route 500) Dec 2024. Six NL properties (Route 500, BUB, Portage Lake, English Lake, Otter Lake, Kan) and three Quebec uranium options (Caboose Lodge, Kawip, Manic). Formerly held Goodeye/Trail Creek (BC) option, abandoned Oct 2025. Also OTCQB listing pending.

name: Emperor Metals Inc.
description: Canadian gold exploration and development company focused on Quebec's Southern Abitibi Greenstone Belt, with its flagship Duquesne West Gold Project and the Lac Pelletier Project.

name: Ameriwest Critical Metals Inc.
description: Critical metals explorer focused on lithium, copper-gold-silver, and REE. Thompson Valley Li (Arizona, ~1402 acres, claystone/hectorite target). Deer Musk East/Clayton Valley Li (Nevada, 10 retained claims ~200 acres). Railroad Valley Li brine (Nevada, 563 claims ~11200 acres, optioned to Pure Energy up to 85%). Bornite Cu-Au-Ag (Oregon, 100% acquired Nov 2025, historic 3.2M short tons @ 2.2% Cu). Xeno RAR REE-Y (BC, option/earn-in, 784 Ha). Formerly Ameriwest Lithium Inc.

name: Aurwest Resources Corp.
description: Gold explorer currently earning into Weaver Lake Gold Project (BC, 725 Ha, earn-in to 50% from Pacific Bay Minerals). Formerly held Stellar Cu-Au (BC, expired), Stars Cu-Mo (BC, sold to Copper Quest Jan 2025), Paradise Lake Au (NL, terminated Feb 2024), Miguels Lake Au (NL, terminated Feb 2024), Stony Caldera Au (NL, terminated Apr 2023). Incorporated as Shamrock Enterprises Inc. 2008; renamed Aurwest Jan 2020.

name: Naughty Ventures Corp.
description: Canadian venture investment and mineral exploration company focused on early-stage mineral projects with significant discovery potential.

name: Barranco Gold Mining Corp.
description: Barranco Gold Mining Corp. is a Canadian gold-focused exploration company advancing its 100%-owned King Property in British Columbia, within the Spences Bridge Gold Belt / south-central British Columbia exploration district.

name: Dark Star Minerals Inc.
description: Dark Star Minerals Inc. (CSE: BATT | FSE: P0W) is a North Vancouver-based junior mineral exploration company focused on the acquisition and development of critical mineral resources, specifically uranium and rare earth elements (REE). The company holds a 100% interest in the Logan REE Property (Quebec), an option to acquire 100% of the Ghost Lake uranium project (28,575 ha, Central Mineral Belt, Labrador), a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of the Bleasdell Lake uranium project (515+ ha, Saskatchewan), and a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Critical One Energy Inc.'s interest in the Cobra North and Khan West uranium projects in Namibia's Erongo uranium province. Total exploration and development portfolio exceeds 26,000 ha. Headquarters: 1056 Handsworth Road, North Vancouver, BC V7R 2A6.

name: Battery X Metals Inc.
description: Energy transition resource exploration and technology company with a diversified approach: (1) exploration of critical battery metal properties; (2) recovery of battery-grade materials from end-of-life Li-ion batteries; (3) diagnostics and rebalancing of Li-ion/EV batteries. Formerly StraightUp Resources Inc. (name changed July 2023). Also listed OTCQB: BATXF and FSE: 5YW.

name: Beaumont Exploration Corp.
description: Junior mining company focused on the exploration and evaluation of its principal property, the Kain Claims, on Vancouver Island in British Columbia.

name: Giant Mining Corp.
description: Giant Mining Corp. is engaged in the identification, review, and acquisition of late-stage copper and copper/silver/gold assets in North America. Its flagship asset is the 100%-controlled Majuba Hill Copper-Silver-Gold Porphyry District in Pershing County, Nevada. Formerly known as Majuba Hill Copper Corp., the company rebranded in April 2024. Also trades as OTC: BFGFF and FWB: YW5. CEO: David Greenway. Incorporated 2017, headquartered in Vancouver, BC.

name: Big Gold Inc.
description: Big Gold Inc. is a junior gold exploration company listed on the CSE with two active mineral properties in Ontario, Canada: the Martin Kenty Project (Kenora/Rainy River Mining District) and the Tabor Project (Shebandowan Greenstone Belt, Thunder Bay South). Both properties are 100%-owned subject to 2% NSR royalties. The company is focused on early-stage exploration with no current NI 43-101 mineral resource estimates.

name: Boreal Gold Inc.
description: Boreal Gold Inc. is a junior mineral exploration company focused on gold and critical metals properties in Manitoba and Saskatchewan, Canada. The company holds option agreements on five properties: the Fay Lake Property (MB), the Melgurd Lake Property (SK), and the North Star Group package comprising the North Star Gold Property, Gold Rock Mining Lease, and Sewell Lake Critical Metals Property (MB), plus the Jewel Box Claim (MB), all in the Flin Flon–Snow Lake greenstone belt.

name: Black Gold Exploration Corp.
description: Black Gold Exploration Corp. is a CSE-listed oil and gas explorer with two primary asset areas: the El Carmen hydrocarbon project (95% interest via Spinell S.A.) in Chubut Province, Argentina, and a strategic Illinois Basin position in Indiana, USA, held through its 100% ownership of EHA1 (30% lease interest) plus a 10% working interest in the Fritz 2-30 well and a 210-acre AMI option.

name: Blue Lagoon Resources Inc.
description: Junior mining company focused on gold and silver production and exploration in British Columbia, Canada. Properties include Dome Mountain (producing gold mine with NI 43-101 resource), Pellaire (gold exploration), and Big Onion (copper-molybdenum exploration).

name: Bahia Metals Corp.
description: Bahia Metals Corp. is a Vancouver-based mineral exploration company focused on advancing the Mangueiros Nickel Sulphide–Copper–Cobalt Project located in Bahia State, northeast Brazil. The company completed its IPO on the CSE in February 2026, raising C$5.75 million. Bahia Metals holds 100% interest in the Mangueiros Project following acquisition of BR NI Holding Company Limited, which owns Bahia Nickel Mineração S.A. The project was originally advanced by investors related to Appian Capital Advisory Limited and is situated in the same state as Appian's producing Santa Rita Nickel Mine.

name: Galloper Gold Corp.
description: Galloper Gold Corp. is a junior gold exploration company focused on its flagship Glover Island Project in western Newfoundland, Canada. The company holds 116.6 km² on Glover Island, including the historic Lunch Pond South Extension (LPSE) gold deposit, the Lucky Smoke discovery, and multiple additional prospects along the Cabot Fault corridor. Strategic investor Dundee Precious Metals holds a position in the company. An updated NI 43-101 resource estimate for the LPSE deposit is in progress with P&E Mining Consultants (expected Q2 2026).

name: Canary Gold Corp.
description: Canary Gold Corp. is an early-stage gold exploration company focused on paleoplacer and sediment-hosted gold targets in the State of Rondônia, Brazil. The company controls approximately 163,145 hectares across two contiguous property blocks (Rio Madeira Project and Talisman Project) in the Madeira River Gold Province. The exploration thesis targets the Mocururu horizon — a lithified, iron-cemented, gold-bearing fluvial conglomerate (duricrust) interpreted as a preserved paleoplacer derived from Andean erosion. The company completed its IPO on the CSE in November 2024 and commenced a 20,000-metre dual-rig drilling program in January 2026.

name: BRS Resources Ltd.
description: BRS Resources Ltd. is a mineral exploration company focused on the identification, evaluation, and acquisition of mineral properties in Canada and the United States. The company is advancing the Cowtrail copper-gold porphyry project in south-central British Columbia under an earn-in option from Cariboo Rose Resources Ltd. BRS also holds a strategic equity position in AleAnna Inc. (NASDAQ: ANNA), an onshore natural gas producer in Italy. Formerly incorporated as Bonanza Resources Corporation (est. May 10, 1967, British Columbia); listed on the CSE on September 3, 2024.

name: Quest Critical Metals Inc.
description: Quest Critical Metals Inc. (formerly Canadian Palladium Resources Inc., 21C Metals Inc., and Declan Cobalt Inc.) is a Vancouver-based junior explorer focused on critical metals. Its primary asset is the Tisova/Klingenthal Copper-Cobalt VMS Project straddling the Czech-German border in the Erzgebirge region. The company also holds the inactive Agnew Lake PGE property in Ontario. Previously held the East Bull Palladium Property (option relinquished March 2024) and Minas Gerais Lithium Project in Brazil (relinquished January 2025). Also trades as DCNNF (OTCQB) and DCR0 (FSE).

name: Burrell Resources Inc.
description: Burrell Resources is a discovery-focused gold explorer with a proven team and an exploration portfolio in northeastern Nevada, USA. Incorporated December 17, 2019 and listed on the CSE on July 9, 2021 following an $800,000 IPO. The company holds an option to earn a 100% interest in the Antelope Project, its sole disclosed property.

name: Beyond Minerals Inc.
description: Beyond Minerals Inc. (formerly Beyond Lithium Inc.; name changed February 2026) is a Canadian junior exploration company listed on the CSE. The company holds three current core projects: the Ear Falls Spodumene Project (Ontario), the Rare One REE Project (British Columbia), and the Owl Creek Copper Porphyry Project (British Columbia). The company previously assembled a large Ontario lithium portfolio of ~66 properties, most of which were rationalized through 2024–2025. Legacy assets include the Fabie-Eastchester gold project in Quebec, which is in the process of being disposed.

name: Bayridge Resources Corp.
description: Bayridge Resources Corp. is a uranium-focused junior explorer listed on the CSE. Its current flagship asset is a 51% indirect interest in the Baker Lake Uranium Project in Nunavut, Canada (Thelon-Baker Basin). It also holds a 40% joint-venture interest in the Waterbury East uranium project in the Athabasca Basin, Saskatchewan (CanAlaska is the 60% lead operator). Former assets — the Constellation Project (Saskatchewan) and Sharpe Lake Lithium Project (Ontario) — were returned/terminated in 2024–2025.

name: Commodore Metals Corp.
description: Junior mining exploration company listed on the CSE (September 29, 2025) holding an exclusive option to acquire 100% of the Keefers-Hannah Gold Project in the Fraser Canyon area of British Columbia, Canada. Sole material asset is the Keefers-Hannah property, comprising 16 mineral claims covering 2,741 hectares.

name: The Canadian Chrome Company Inc.
description: The Canadian Chrome Company Inc. (formerly KWG Resources Inc.) is a junior mining company focused on chromite and Ring of Fire district assets in northern Ontario, Canada. Key properties include Black Horse/Koper Lake (100%), Big Daddy (30% vested interest), Hornby (100%), McFaulds Lake/Spider No. 3 (15% vested interest), and Fishtrap Lake (100%). The company also holds direct-reduction-of-chromite IP through Muketi Metallurgical LP.

name: Canadian GoldCamps Corp.
description: Canadian GoldCamps Corp. (formerly Supreme Metals Corp.) is a CSE-listed Canadian junior exploration company. Historical and current portfolio has included Canadian gold, cobalt, iron, uranium and lithium properties as well as Peruvian lithium/uranium and Spanish lithium-tin-tantalum pegmatite exposures. As of Jan. 2, 2026 the active growth focus is two Quebec gold projects (Courcy and Mercator) acquired on a letter-of-intent basis from Stelmine Canada Ltd.

name: Canadian Uranium Corp.
description: Canadian Uranium Corp. (formerly Free Battery Metal Limited, formerly Titus Energy Corp.) is a CSE-listed junior exploration company focused on uranium and critical metals projects in Canada. The company holds the Mound Lake gallium/critical metals property in Ontario (optioned up to 80% to Snow Lake Energy), the Lac Binette critical metals property in Quebec, and is acquiring the King South uranium property in the eastern Athabasca Basin, Saskatchewan.

name: Caprock Mining Corp.
description: Caprock Mining Corp. (formerly Blingold Corp., incorporated Sept 14, 2020) is a junior exploration company with a flagship gold project (Destiny) in the Abitibi Greenstone Belt of Quebec, six gold properties in the Beardmore-Geraldton Gold Belt of Ontario, and a lithium (zinnwaldite)/Sn-Mo-REE property (Ackley) in Newfoundland.

name: Carmanah Minerals Corp.
description: Canadian junior mineral exploration company focused on precious metals, uranium and rare earth elements across projects in Newfoundland and Labrador, Saskatchewan (Athabasca Basin) and British Columbia. Current flagship is the Heritage Gold-Silver Project on the Burin Peninsula, NL.

name: Cascade Copper Corp.
description: Junior mineral exploration company focused on copper-gold porphyry and orogenic gold projects in British Columbia and Ontario, Canada. Five properties: Rogers Creek (flagship), Fire Mountain, Bendor, Copper Plateau, and Centrefire.

name: CAT Strategic Metals Corporation
description: CAT Strategic Metals Corporation is a junior exploration company with a portfolio of precious, base, battery and critical metals projects across North America and Africa. Active projects include Gold Jackpot (Nevada), Burntland (New Brunswick), and Siurivvik REE (Nunavik, Quebec).

name: Carlyle Commodities Corp.
description: Canadian junior mineral exploration company focused on precious and base metal projects. Current assets: Quesnel Gold Project and Nicola East (both British Columbia). Historical portfolio includes the Newton Gold-Silver Project (sold to Axcap Ventures in June 2025) and several other former or JV properties.

name: Canadian Copper Inc.
description: Canadian Copper Inc. (successor to Melius Metals Corp.) is a CSE-listed junior copper developer focused on the Bathurst Mining Camp of New Brunswick, Canada. Its flagship asset is the 100%-owned Murray Brook VMS deposit, with a current NI 43-101 MRE of 21.1 Mt M+I @ 1.42% CuEq. CCI is also acquiring the nearby Caribou Processing Complex (3,000 tpd mill) to support a hub-and-spoke development strategy.

name: Green River Gold Corp.
description: Green River Gold Corp. is a British Columbia-focused junior explorer holding a portfolio of hard-rock and placer mineral properties across the Cariboo and southeastern BC mining districts. Core projects include the Fontaine Gold Project, Quesnel Nickel/Magnesium/Talc Project, Kymar Silver Project, KaLi Pegmatite Project, Midnight Special Gold-Silver-Copper Prospect, and the active Wabi placer gold operation on the Swift River.

name: CDN Maverick Capital Corp.
description: CDN Maverick Capital Corp. (CSE: CDN | OTCQB: AXVEF) is a junior mineral exploration company focused on lithium, gold, and polymetallic critical minerals projects across Canada, the USA, and Argentina. Its core asset is the Chabinoche-Poncheville-Nottaway property in Quebec's James Bay region.

name: Cartier Silver Corporation
description: Cartier Silver Corporation (formerly Cartier Iron Corporation) is a junior exploration company with a portfolio of three properties: the Chorrillos silver-polymetallic project in Potosi, Bolivia; the Gagnon Holdings iron ore JV in the Labrador Trough, Quebec; and the Big Easy epithermal gold-silver property on the Burin Peninsula, Newfoundland.

name: Clarity Metals Corp.
description: Canadian junior exploration company (formerly Clarity Gold Corp., renamed Dec 12, 2022) focused on gold and critical metals in Canada. Primary focus is the 100%-owned Fecteau Gold Project in the Urban-Barry Greenstone Belt, Quebec. Portfolio also includes optioned Lithium381 (James Bay, QC), plus early-stage Cu-Au-Mo, Ni, and Pb-Zn properties in BC and Newfoundland & Labrador.

name: CMP Mining Inc.
description: CMP Mining Inc. (formerly Vanadium 23 Capital Corporation; incorporated January 30, 2018 as 1151139 BC Ltd.) is a British Columbia-based junior exploration company focused on the identification, acquisition, exploration and evaluation of mineral gold properties in Canada. Head office: Suite 2820, 200 Granville Street, Vancouver, BC. Sole property is the Coquigold Property in southern BC, on which CMP holds an option to earn a 70% interest from Cariboo Rose Resources Ltd.

name: Cullinan Metals Corp
description: Cullinan Metals Corp is a junior exploration company incorporated January 29, 2021 under the BC Business Corporations Act and listed on the CSE (Feb 16, 2022). The company has focused on graphite and lithium exploration in Quebec and Ontario. As of Q1 FY2025 (Sep 30, 2024), active properties are: Lac-des-Îles West Graphite (Quebec, pending assignment to Air Carbon Raw Materials Inc.) and Wakeman Lake Lithium (Ontario). No NI 43-101 resource estimates have been filed and no drilling has been conducted on any Cullinan property. The company also trades OTC (CMTNF) and Frankfurt (7KO).

name: Collective Metals Inc.
description: Collective Metals Inc. is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on uranium and critical metals. Its current flagship is the Rocas Uranium Project in the eastern Athabasca Basin, Saskatchewan, where it can earn a 75% interest via a definitive option/JV agreement with Standard Uranium. The company also holds two Ontario lithium pegmatite properties (Landings Lake and Whitemud Lake) acquired in 2023. Former projects include the Princeton Copper Project (BC, option terminated 2025-07-08) and the Up Town Gold Property (NWT, option terminated 2023-08-09).

name: Copper Quest Exploration Inc.
description: Copper Quest Exploration Inc. (formerly Interra Copper Corp. / IMC International Mining Corp.) is a CSE-listed junior exploration company with a portfolio of 8 copper, copper-gold and gold projects across British Columbia, Canada and Idaho, USA, totaling approximately 46,000+ hectares. Flagship assets include the Stars, Stellar and Rip copper-molybdenum porphyry projects in the Bulkley Porphyry Belt, the legacy Thane porphyry in the Quesnel Terrane, the Kitimat Cu-Au project, the past-producing Alpine Gold mine in the West Kootenays, and the Nekash and Auxer Gold projects in Idaho.

name: Canter Resources Corp.
description: Canadian junior exploration company (CSE: CRC | OTC: CNRCF) focused on lithium and boron brine/sediment projects in Nevada and Montana, USA. Flagship asset is the Columbus Lithium-Boron Project in Esmeralda County, Nevada. QP: Eric Saderholm, P.Geo.

name: Corcel Exploration Inc.
description: Junior mineral exploration company focused on copper, gold and critical minerals in North America. Flagship Yuma King Cu-Au skarn/porphyry project in Arizona, plus the Willow copper property in British Columbia.

name: Carson River Ventures Corp.
description: British Columbia-incorporated (2021), Vancouver-based exploration-stage company focused on the identification, acquisition, exploration and evaluation of mineral properties in the United States. Listed on the CSE February 7, 2022. Sole asset is an option on the Chucker Property in Mineral County, Nevada. A proposed RTO with Novcorp (DRC tin trading) announced December 2023 was terminated October 15, 2024.

name: Cruz Battery Metals Corp.
description:
Cruz Battery Metals Corp. is a junior explorer focused on battery-metals
    projects critical to the green-energy transition. Its flagship is the Solar Lithium
    Project (Nevada), a sediment-hosted lithium claystone deposit in the Siebert Formation,
    Big Smoky Valley, Nye County, Nevada, directly adjacent to American Lithium's TLC
    project. Cruz also holds three Clayton Valley, Nevada lithium brine properties (two
    100%-owned, one JV), the Idaho Cobalt Belt Project (Idaho), and the Sterling South
    Gold/Copper Project (Ontario). Stantec was engaged in January 2026 to produce a maiden
    NI 43-101 resource estimate for the Solar project.

name: Canamex Gold Corp.
description: Canadian junior gold explorer. Historically held the Bruner Gold Project in Nevada (sold to Endeavour Silver Corp. for US$10M in Sep 2021), the Aranka North Gold Project in Guyana (100% owned, care & maintenance), and briefly held an option on the Silverton Gold Property in Nevada (2017–2019, cancelled).

name: Copper Standard Resources Inc.
description: Americas-focused copper-gold exploration company with four properties in Peru: El Ferrol (Colpayoc), Pacaska, Capricho, and Paco Orco. Formerly Level 14 Ventures Ltd. (name changed December 2023). Acquired the Pacaska, Capricho, and Paco Orco projects via the Pucara Gold Ltd. merger completed November 20, 2024.

name: Cupani Metals Corp.
description: Cupani Metals Corp. (formerly IC Capitalight Corp., renamed December 2024) is a junior exploration company focused on magmatic Cu-Ni-PGE sulphide mineralization in the Labrador Trough, Quebec. Its flagship Blue Lake Property hosts nine historical Cu-Ni-PGE sulphide lens deposits and a 682 km² land package targeting analogues to the Raglan Mine and Voisey's Bay Mine. The company commenced its first diamond drill program as Cupani in March 2026.

name: Super Copper Corp.
description: Super Copper Corp. is a junior mineral exploration company focused on copper-gold discovery in the Atacama Region of Chile. The company holds two flagship properties totalling over 14,000 ha: the Cordillera Cobre Project (earn-in JV) and the 100%-owned Castilla Project, both targeting IOCG-style mineralization in one of the world's premier copper-producing districts.

name: CMX Gold & Silver Corp.
description: CMX Gold & Silver Corp. is a junior exploration company focused on its flagship 100%-owned Clayton Silver Property in Custer County, Idaho (Bayhorse Mining District). The Clayton property is a past-producing underground Ag-Pb-Zn-Cu mine held through wholly-owned subsidiary CMX Gold & Silver (USA) Corp. The company also holds an associated surface stockpile/ore-sorting program at the Clayton site. A former earn-in interest in the Marietta Exploration Project in Mineral County, Nevada was terminated in 2013.

name: Discovery Energy Metals Corp.
description: Discovery Energy Metals Corp. (formerly Discovery Lithium Inc. until April 1, 2025; formerly ISM Resources Corp. until September 2023) is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on critical minerals. The company holds a large portfolio of early-stage exploration properties targeting lithium (LCT pegmatite), gold, copper, and molybdenum across Quebec, Ontario, British Columbia, and Nevada. CEO: Mike Hodge (appointed July 18, 2024). Key technical advisors include Shawn Ryan (prospector) and Dahrouge Geological Consulting Ltd. (QP: Jonathan Marleau, P.Geo.). No NI 43-101 resource estimates exist on any property as of July 2025. Parent company: Ameriwest Lithium Inc. OTC: DEMCF (formerly DCLIF). Frankfurt: Q3Q0.

name: DRC Gold Corp.
description: DRC Gold Corp. (formerly AJN Resources Inc.) is a Vancouver-based junior exploration company focused on acquiring and developing gold and lithium projects in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Ethiopia. The company's management team has over 50 years of combined experience operating in the DRC and has been involved in the discovery of world-class deposits including the Kibali Gold deposit and the Manono Lithium deposit. DRC Gold's flagship assets are the Giro and Nizi Gold Projects, both located in the highly prospective Kilo-Moto Greenstone Belt of north-eastern DRC, approximately 35km from the world-class Kibali Gold Mine.

name: EagleOne Metals Corporation
description: EagleOne Metals Corporation (CSE: EAGL; FSE: I2J) is a British Columbia-incorporated mineral exploration company focused on the identification, acquisition, exploration and development of mineral projects in Canada and internationally. Incorporated August 8, 2022; listed on the CSE August 27, 2024. The company holds three properties: the Magusi West Gold Project (Quebec, 100%-owned), the Surupampa I Mining Concession (Northern Peru, acquisition pending CSE approval), and the Poison Springs U/REE Project (Utah, USA, binding LOI stage). CEO and President: Matthew Markin. QP: Allan MacTavish, MSc. P.Geo.

name: New Earth Resources Corp.
description: New Earth Resources Corp. (formerly Oberon Uranium Corp., CSE: OBRN until September 19, 2025) is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on uranium and rare earth elements (REE). The company holds a past-producing uranium project in Arizona, uranium claims in northern Saskatchewan, and two early-stage REE projects in Quebec and Labrador acquired in late 2025. The company divested two uranium properties in Saskatchewan (Element 92 and Fusion Uranium Zone) in 2024–2025.

name: Edgemont Gold Corp.
description: Edgemont Gold Corp. is a CSE-listed junior exploration company holding an option to acquire 100% of the Dungate copper-gold-molybdenum porphyry project near Houston, British Columbia. The company is also pursuing a pending reverse takeover of Laiva Gold Inc., which holds the advanced-stage, past-producing Laiva (Otso) gold mine in Finland (6,000 tpd plant, care and maintenance). Edgemont was incorporated August 2, 2018, listed on the CSE May 29, 2020, and has completed two diamond drill programs at Dungate (Phase I: 7 holes / 3,427 m in 2021; Phase II: 5 holes / 2,063 m in 2022).

name: Evolution Global Frontier Ventures Corp.
description: Evolution Global Frontier Ventures Corp. (formerly Ascension Exploration Inc.) is an early-stage mineral exploration company focused on the acquisition, exploration and development of gold and other mineral properties. The company holds a 90% working interest in the Pichogen gold property in Walls Township, Ontario, and an option on a copper-gold porphyry property in the Omineca Mining Division of British Columbia. The company listed on the CSE on December 11, 2020 and has 13,650,000 shares outstanding. Trading is currently suspended on the CSE. CEO: Paul Haber (phaber@summitbancorp.com, 416-318-6501). Address: 4 Claudia Drive, Whitby, ON L1M 1K7.

name: Element79 Gold Corp.
description: Element79 Gold Corp. is a junior gold exploration company focused on its flagship Lucero past-producing high-grade Au-Ag epithermal project in Arequipa, Peru, along with exploration-stage Nevada properties including the Elephant Project (skarn/porphyry), Gold Mountain Project (porphyry/structurally controlled Au-Ag), and Clover Project (low-sulphidation epithermal Au-Ag). The company acquired 16 Nevada properties from Waterton in December 2021 and has been rationalizing the portfolio since 2023.

name: Canamera Energy Metals Corp.
description: Canadian-listed junior exploration company (CSE: EMET | OTCQB: EMETF | FRA: 4LF0) focused on rare earth elements, uranium and critical minerals across Brazil, the USA and Canada. Portfolio includes ionic clay REE projects in Brazil (Turvolândia, São Sepé, Patos), carbonatite and alkaline REE projects in the USA and Ontario (Iron Hills, Schryburt Lake, Waterslide, Garrow), a uranium earn-in in Wyoming (Great Divide Basin) and a legacy BC asset (Mantle).

name: EMP Metals Corp.
description: EMP Metals Corp. is a pre-revenue lithium brine exploration and development company focused on the Williston Basin of southeastern Saskatchewan, Canada. The company holds over 205,000 net acres (83,000+ Ha) of Subsurface Crown Mineral Dispositions targeting lithium-bearing brines in the Duperow Formation, held 100% through its wholly owned subsidiary Hub City Lithium Corp. (HCL). EMP is advancing its flagship Viewfield Project toward commercialization via Project Aurora, a demonstration-scale Direct Lithium Extraction (DLE) plant operated in partnership with Saltworks Technologies Inc. The Aug 2025 NI 43-101 MRE defines 931,038 t indicated LCE and 1,117,225 t inferred LCE across the Viewfield and Mansur project areas.

name: Eco Oro Minerals Corp.
description: Eco Oro Minerals Corp. is a Canadian junior mining company with a portfolio of gold-silver exploration and development assets in northeastern Colombia, centered on the Angostura high-sulfidation epithermal deposit in Santander Department. Since 2016, the company has been primarily focused on international arbitration against the Republic of Colombia following regulatory measures that curtailed rights over portions of its principal Concession 3452.

name: Element One Hydrogen and Critical Minerals Corp.
description: Element One Hydrogen and Critical Minerals Corp. (formerly Buscando Resources Corp.; name changed October 2025) is a Vancouver-based junior exploration company pioneering a tripartite approach combining geologic hydrogen exploration, critical minerals extraction, and carbon sequestration. The company holds interests in the Star Project (north-central BC; ultramafic; hydrogen), the Foggy Mountain Property (BC; Cu-Au skarn/porphyry/epithermal), and the Union Bay Project (SE Alaska; ultramafic; hydrogen), which has been vended into a private subsidiary. The company has also signed a definitive agreement to acquire the Stone to H2 technology for subsurface hydrogen and critical mineral extraction from ultramafic rock.

name: Epic Gold Corp.
description: Epic Gold Corp. (formerly Exploits Discovery Corp., renamed Feb 18, 2026) is a Canadian junior gold exploration company listed on the CSE. The company divested substantially all of its Newfoundland mineral claims to New Found Gold Corp. (TSXV: NFG) in December 2025, receiving up to 3,547,100 NFG shares (deemed ~$8.8M) plus a 1% NSR royalty on the sold claims. Epic Gold now focuses on three optioned Quebec gold projects (Fenton, Wilson, Benoist — all optioned from Cartier Resources Inc.) and one optioned Ontario gold project (Hawkins — optioned from Pavey Ark Minerals Inc.), while retaining two NL claim packages (Mount Peyton, True Grit) and its NFG equity and royalty position. Total historical (non-current) resources across its active portfolio exceed ~560,000 oz Au.

name: E-Power Resources Inc.
description: E-Power Resources Inc. is a junior graphite exploration company focused on advancing its flagship Tetepisca Graphite Property in the Tetepisca Graphite District (TGD) of Quebec, one of North America's premier flake graphite districts. The company also holds the non-core Turgeon Property in Abitibi, Quebec, which it is seeking to sell.

name: Eureka Lithium Corp.
description: Eureka Lithium Corp. (formerly Scout Minerals Corp., renamed June 2023) is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on critical minerals. Its flagship portfolio comprises three large lithium-cesium-rubidium hard-rock spodumene pegmatite properties in Nunavik, Quebec (Raglan West, Raglan South, New Leaf), totalling over 1,400 sq km acquired from legendary prospector Shawn Ryan. The company also holds an option on the Lac La Motte Lithium Project near Val-d'Or, QC (La Corne Batholith), and recently acquired 100% interests in the Cabin Lake Polymetallic Project (Zn-Pb-Cu-Mo-Ag, central BC) and the Tyee Titanium-Vanadium Project (TiO2-V2O5, Cote-Nord, QC) via the acquisition of Stairway Mining Inc. (February 2026).

name: ESGold Corp.
description: ESGold Corp. (formerly Secova Metals Corp.; name changed July 2022) is a junior mining company focused on gold and silver production from tailings reprocessing and hard-rock exploration in Québec and Ontario, Canada. Its flagship Montauban Gold-Silver Project in Québec is fully permitted with a completed mill building, targeting 2026 production commencement. The 2025 NI 43-101 PEA (eff. July 21, 2025) returned an after-tax NPV5% of C$24.27M and IRR of 60.3%.

name: Etruscus Resources Corp.
description: Vancouver-based junior mineral exploration company focused on the acquisition and development of precious and base metal mineral properties in Canada. Flagship asset is the 100%-owned Rock & Roll Property (~29,344 ha) in BC's prolific Golden Triangle near the past-producing Snip Mine, hosting the Black Dog VMS deposit, porphyry Cu-Au targets (Zappa), and a rare earth element target (Hendrix/Pheno). Also traded as ETRUF (OTC) and ERR (Frankfurt Stock Exchange).

name: EV Minerals Corporation
description: EV Minerals Corporation (CSE: EVM; FSE: RLC) is a Canadian junior exploration company holding nickel-copper-cobalt assets in Quebec and copper assets in Chile, alongside gold-nickel-copper-PGE projects in the Sudbury Mining Camp, Ontario. As of August 2025 the company has entered a three-cornered amalgamation agreement to form Three Points Copper Inc., with the Santa Monica Copper Project in Chile becoming the flagship asset of the resulting issuer.

name: Foremost Clean Energy Ltd.
description: Foremost Clean Energy Ltd. (CSE: FAT | NASDAQ: FMST) is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on uranium and lithium. Its uranium portfolio consists of 10 properties in the Athabasca Basin, Saskatchewan (optioned from Denison Mines). Its lithium portfolio is concentrated in the Snow Lake district of Manitoba (Lithium Lane) and includes the Zoro Lithium Project (NI 43-101 inferred resource) and Jean Lake Lithium-Gold property. The company also holds Lac Simard South in Quebec. Foremost spun out its Winston Gold-Silver property (New Mexico) to Rio Grande Resources Ltd. (CSE: RGR) effective January 31, 2025, retaining a 19.95% stake in RGR.

name: FenixOro Gold Corp.
description: FenixOro Gold Corp. is a junior gold exploration and development company focused on high-grade epithermal gold-silver systems in the northern Mid-Cauca gold belt of Antioquia, Colombia. Its flagship Abriaqui Project is located approximately 15 km west of the producing Buritica mine. The company also holds an operating high-grade gold mine (Escondida) in northeast Antioquia and has announced a conditional acquisition of the El Porvenir mine and permitted processing facility contiguous to the Abriaqui district.

name: First Lithium Minerals Corp.
description: First Lithium Minerals Corp. is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on lithium brine exploration in northern Chile (OCA Prospect) and gold/critical minerals exploration in northwestern Ontario. The company went public via RTO in July 2022 and trades on the CSE. Its flagship asset is the OCA Salar de Ascotan Project in Chile's Antofagasta Region, where inaugural drilling is planned for H2 2025.

name: Four Nines Gold Inc.
description: Four Nines Gold Inc. is a Vancouver-based junior exploration company (formerly Eureka Dome Gold Inc., renamed November 2016) focused on the Hayden Hill Gold-Silver Project in Lassen County, California — a past-producing low-sulfidation epithermal deposit previously operated by Amax Gold (1992–1997), which recovered approximately 483,000 oz Au and 1.34 Moz Ag. FNAU holds an exploration agreement and option to acquire 100% of Lassen Gold Mining Inc. (a Kinross subsidiary) from Kinam Gold Inc. The company also holds an option on the Bonneville gold-silver-copper property in central Quebec. No NI 43-101 compliant resource estimate exists for any property.

name: Fathom Nickel Inc.
description: Fathom Nickel Inc. is a junior exploration company focused on magmatic nickel sulphide discovery in the La Ronge Nickel Belt of Saskatchewan, Canada. Its three-property portfolio — Albert Lake, Gochager Lake, and Friesen Lake — targets Rottenstone-style Ni-Cu-Co-PGE mineralization hosted in ultramafic intrusions within the Trans-Hudson Orogen.

name: FNX Inc.
description: FNX Inc. (formerly S2 Minerals Inc., renamed Dec 5 2025) is a junior gold exploration company focused on the Sandy Lake Greenstone Belt of northwestern Ontario. Its primary asset is the 100%-owned Sandy Lake Gold Project (~137,000 acres core block) plus two joint-venture blocks totalling ~30,000 acres. The company also holds an option on the Fort Hope Gold Project north of Thunder Bay, and additional claim packages in the Veekay Lake area of NW Ontario.

name: Fox River Resources Corporation
description: Fox River Resources Corporation is a Canadian junior mineral exploration company focused on the 100%-owned Martison Phosphate Project in Ontario. The project hosts a large phosphate and niobium deposit within a weathered carbonatite complex approximately 70 km northeast of Hearst, Ontario. The company is pursuing a phased development strategy underpinned by a 2022 Preliminary Economic Assessment and is collaborating with CanmetMINING on beneficiation and niobium extraction research.

name: Forge Resources Corp.
description: Forge Resources Corp. is a junior mineral exploration and resource development company listed on the CSE. Its flagship asset is the Alotta copper-gold porphyry project in the Yukon, held under option from Strategic Metals Ltd. The company also holds an 80% interest in Aion Mining Corp., which controls the fully permitted La Estrella coal project in Santander, Colombia. The company was formerly known as Benjamin Hill Mining Corp. and previously operated the Benjamin Hill / Sonora property in Sonora, Mexico, whose option agreements were terminated in 2023.

name: First Tellurium Corp.
description: First Tellurium Corp. (CSE: FTEL | OTC: FSTTF) is an exploration-stage company focused on tellurium and polymetallic projects in North America. Its flagship Deer Horn Property in west-central British Columbia hosts North America's only NI 43-101 compliant Au-Ag-Te resource, complemented by a Cu-Au porphyry target. The Colorado Klondike property in Saguache County, Colorado is a former First Solar tellurium exploration target with high-grade surface samples. In 2024 the company acquired 75% of PyroDelta Energy Corp., a tellurium-based thermoelectric generator technology subsidiary.

name: Gold'n Futures Mineral Corp.
description: Gold'n Futures Mineral Corp. is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on gold and polymetallic mineral properties in Ontario, Newfoundland and Labrador, and British Columbia. Its flagship asset is the Hercules Gold Project in Ontario's Beardmore-Geraldton gold camp, held under option from Argonaut Gold Inc. The company also holds the Brady-Huxter Gold Project and Handcamp Gold and Silver Property in Newfoundland, and copper-porphyry/REE claims in south-central British Columbia. NOTE: A Management Cease Trade Order was issued May 1, 2025; corporate status should be verified before reliance on this data.

name: Flow Metals Corp.
description: Flow Metals Corp. is a Canadian junior explorer focused on gold and copper-molybdenum porphyry exploration, with active projects in Yukon and British Columbia. The company holds 100% of the Sixtymile gold property (Yukon), 100% of the New Brenda copper-molybdenum porphyry property (BC), and an option to acquire 100% of the Monster IOCG property (Yukon, optioned from Go Metals Corp. in February 2026).

name: Gander Gold Corporation
description: Gander Gold Corporation is a junior exploration company focused on gold discovery in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada. The company holds a portfolio of eight exploration-stage properties across central and southwest Newfoundland, assembled from the Vulcan Minerals and Wildwood Exploration option packages originally assembled by predecessor company Sassy Resources. As of the latest reviewed filings (March 31, 2025), four properties remain active under the Vulcan option package (Gander North, Gander South, Little River, Hermitage), while several Wildwood-optioned properties (Mount Peyton, BLT, Cape Ray II, Carmanville) are in default or fully impaired.

name: Goldcana Resources Inc.
description: Goldcana Resources Inc. is a junior exploration company incorporated in 2023 and listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE) on August 13, 2025. Headquartered in White Rock, British Columbia, the company is focused on the identification, acquisition, exploration and development of mineral properties in Canada. Its flagship asset is the Triple F Gold Project, located approximately 28 km northwest of Kelowna, BC, in the Nicola and Vernon Mining Divisions.

name: Golden Cariboo Resources Ltd.
description: Golden Cariboo Resources Ltd. is a junior gold exploration company focused on its flagship Quesnelle Gold Quartz Mine Property in the Cariboo Mining Division of central British Columbia. The company is advancing the newly discovered Halo Zone — a near-surface, bulk-tonnage orogenic gold system — through systematic diamond drilling and has announced plans to commission an NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate for the Halo and Main zones. Its total land position exceeds 95,000 ha, bordered by Osisko Development's Cariboo Gold Project.

name: Golcap Resources Corp.
description: Golcap Resources Corp. is a CSE-listed junior exploration company with a diversified portfolio of gold, vanadium, and titanium projects across British Columbia (Canada), northern Quebec (Canada), southern Finland, and Pará State (Brazil). The company is at the exploration stage with no NI 43-101 compliant resource on any property as of March 2026.

name: Golden Age Exploration Ltd.
description: Golden Age Exploration Ltd. is a CSE-listed junior mineral exploration company focused on gold-silver targets in British Columbia, Canada. Its asset base comprises three properties: the Magic Property (earn-in to 80%, Cariboo region), and the Black Hawk Gold Project plus Thompson Claims (collectively the Thompson Gold Project, Vernon Mining Division), acquired in December 2025.

name: Grafton Resources Inc.
description: Grafton Resources Inc. (formerly Prisma Exploration Inc. until Sep 22, 2025) is a Vancouver-based early-stage junior explorer focused on acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in Canada and Chile. Primary focus is copper, silver, and gold. Also trades on OTCQB as GFTFF. Incorporated 2018; name change effective September 25, 2025.

name: Generic Gold Corp.
description: Generic Gold Corp. is a junior gold exploration company listed on the CSE. The company holds a flagship Belvais Project in the Abitibi region of Québec and a portfolio of over 35,000 ha of gold-focused exploration properties in Yukon, Canada.

name: General Copper Gold Corp.
description: General Copper Gold Corp. (formerly General Gold Resources Inc.) is a junior exploration company listed on the CSE. The company holds a 50.1% earned interest in the Topley Richfield polymetallic property in British Columbia, with an option to earn the remaining 49.9%. A former option on the Clark's Brook gold property in Newfoundland was terminated in 2022.

name: Golden Goose Resources Corp.
description: Golden Goose Resources Corp. (formerly SALi Lithium Corp., ticker SALI until Oct 1, 2025) is a multi-commodity junior explorer listed on the CSE (GGR) and OTCQB (GGRFF). The company holds a portfolio of six properties across Argentina and Quebec, Canada, targeting gold, silver, copper, and lithium. Key assets include the Gran Esperanza high-grade epithermal gold project in Río Negro, Argentina (earn-in to 100%), the El Quemado hard-rock lithium pegmatite project in Salta, Argentina, and the Goldfire orogenic gold property in Quebec's Urban-Barry Greenstone Belt (42 km west of Windfall). No drilling has been completed on any property as of March 2026; three sets of surface sample assay results were pending.

name: Golden Spike Resources Corp.
description: Golden Spike Resources Corp. is a junior exploration company focused on the Gregory River copper-gold-zinc VMS project in western Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada. The property is situated within the Lower Ordovician Bay of Islands Ophiolite Complex, the same geological belt hosting the York Harbour VMS deposit 27 km to the south.

name: Golden Lake Exploration Inc.
description: Golden Lake Exploration Inc. is a junior exploration company focused on its flagship Jewel Ridge Project in Eureka County, Nevada, USA — a high-grade, multi-target gold-silver-lead-zinc system hosting both Carlin-type and carbonate replacement deposit (CRD) mineralization along the ~10 km Jackson Fault corridor. The company also holds (or held) the Copperview copper-gold porphyry project in south-central British Columbia. On January 28, 2026, McEwen Inc. announced a definitive agreement to acquire all outstanding GLM shares at C$0.12/share (60% premium), pending shareholder and regulatory approval.

name: Germanium Mining Corp.
description: Germanium Mining Corp. (formerly Musk Metals Corp., name changed effective June 9, 2025; 10:1 share consolidation concurrent) is a junior exploration company listed on the CSE. The company holds a portfolio of properties in Quebec, British Columbia, and Nevada, with a strategic focus on germanium and gallium critical minerals. Its flagship assets are the Azure Ridge Project (Clark County, Nevada – historic Kipushi-type CRD polymetallic system with Ge, Ga, Cu, Zn, Pb) and the Lac du Km 35 Germanium Property (Nord-du-Québec, highest Ge outcrop value recorded in Quebec at 186 ppm). The broader portfolio includes lithium, uranium, gold, and polymetallic properties across Quebec and British Columbia.

name: Gelum Resources Ltd.
description: Gelum Resources is a junior gold exploration company listed on the CSE. Its core historical focus was the Eldorado Gold Project in the Bralorne-Bridge River gold district of British Columbia. As of 2025, the only confirmed held claim is the Roxey Claims (100% owned). In February 2026 Gelum announced a letter of intent to acquire the Las Tinajas Gold Project in the Maricunga Belt, Chile.

name: Go Metals Corp.
description: Go Metals Corp. is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on critical and battery metals. Its flagship HSP Ni-Cu-PGE project is located in Quebec's Côte-Nord region. The company also holds the KM98 Fe-Ti-V project (Quebec), the Oriole Ni-Cu grassroots property (Quebec), and through subsidiary Deep Hydrogen Corp., five natural hydrogen properties in Ontario and Quebec. The Monster IOCG Copper-Cobalt property (Yukon) was optioned to Flow Metals Corp. in February 2026, with Go Metals retaining a 2% NSR.

name: GoldHaven Resources Corp.
description: GoldHaven Resources Corp. is a junior exploration company focused on district-scale polymetallic and gold projects in British Columbia and Brazil. Current assets include the flagship Magno polymetallic project (Cassiar District, BC), the Three Guardsmen copper-gold skarn project (northwestern BC), and a portfolio of gold and critical-mineral properties in Brazil acquired through the January 2025 purchase of Boa Gold Corp.

name: Goldrea Resources Corp.
description: Goldrea Resources Corp. is a junior gold-copper exploration company focused on the Golden Triangle of northwest British Columbia. Its flagship asset is the Cannonball Project, a multi-target porphyry Cu-Au and high-grade gold vein system located ~15 km northeast of the former Snip Mine. The company controls approximately 3,921 ha of 100%-owned claims plus up to 514 ha under earn-in agreements. No drilling has been completed by Goldrea as of the research date; all drill data is historic. A multi-year area-based drill permit is in place for the Cannonball Project.

name: Gold Port Corporation
description: Gold Port Corporation is a junior mining company focused on advancing the Groete Gold Copper Project in Guyana, South America — reported to be Guyana's third largest gold-copper deposit. The company also holds an option on the L.A.B. Graphite Project in Quebec. Formerly known as Gold Port Resources Ltd. and Corsurex Resource Corp., the company listed on the CSE under symbol GPO following a 2-for-1 share consolidation in September 2020. As of early 2026, the company is constructing a 13 km access road to the Groete site in advance of a planned 10,000m infill and expansion drill program.

name: Graycliff Exploration Limited
description: Graycliff Exploration Limited is a junior gold exploration company focused on the Shakespeare Gold Project in Ontario, Canada — an ~1,468 ha land package ~88 km west of Sudbury hosting a high-grade, near-surface quartz-vein gold system. The company completed four drill phases (2020–2022) totalling 61 holes and over 12,500 m. As of March 2025, the company has signed a non-binding LOI for a reverse takeover transaction with Emergent Waste Solutions.

name: Green Bridge Metals Corporation
description: Green Bridge Metals Corporation is a junior exploration company focused on critical and base metals in Ontario (Canada) and the Duluth Complex of Minnesota (USA). The company holds option interests in the Chrome-Puddy and Danby Triangle Ni-Cu-PGE properties in Ontario (optioned from Pavey Ark Minerals), and the South Contact Zone district package in Minnesota (optioned from Encampment Minerals Inc.), which includes the Titac, Skibo, Wyman-Siphon and Boulder properties. In 2025 the company also entered a definitive option agreement to earn up to 70% of the Serpentine Cu-Ni-Co project in northern Minnesota, adjacent to NewRange Copper Nickel's NorthMet and Sunrise projects.

name: Geologica Resource Corp.
description: Geologica Resource Corp. (formerly Cabbay Holdings Corp., renamed February 2021) is a Canadian junior mineral exploration company listed on the CSE. The company holds three properties in British Columbia: the Topley Copper-Gold Project (porphyry Cu-Au, Omineca Mining Division), the Titan Polymetallic Property (Cu-Au-Ag-Pb-Zn with critical minerals Sb and Te, Atlin Mining Division), and the Lincoln Lode Gold and Lincoln Placer claims (lode and placer gold, Atlin Mining Division). As of March 2025, no drilling has been completed by Geologica on any property; all drill data is from historical programs by prior operators. No NI 43-101 compliant resource estimates exist on any property.

name: Greenhawk Resources Inc.
description: Greenhawk Resources Inc. (formerly Cryptologic Corp.) is a junior exploration company focused on the Storø Gold Project in southwest Greenland, held through its wholly-owned subsidiary Copenhagen Minerals Inc. The company acquired the Storø assets in May 2021 and holds 100% legal and beneficial interest in two mineral exploration licences (MEL 2014/11 and MEL 2021-01) and one prospecting licence (2020-62) in Greenland.

name: Protium Clean Energy Corp.
description: Protium Clean Energy Corp. (formerly Weekapaug Lithium Ltd.) is a junior explorer focused on natural/geological hydrogen and lithium-cesium-tantalum (LCT) pegmatite exploration in Ontario and British Columbia, Canada. The company holds the flagship Nakina Lithium Property in Northern Ontario, multiple Firstbrook/Temiskaming natural hydrogen claims in Ontario, and a Right of First Refusal over the Cheslatta Lake Claims in central BC. Listed on the CSE under symbol GRUV since February 2023; name changed from Weekapaug Lithium to Protium Clean Energy in November 2024 to reflect its broadened clean energy exploration strategy.

name: Golden Shield Resources Inc.
description: Golden Shield Resources Inc. is a junior gold exploration company listed on the CSE (GSRI), OTCQB (GSRFF), and Frankfurt Exchange (4LE0). The company holds three 100%-owned gold exploration properties in Guyana: the flagship Marudi Mountain project (Rupununi District, SW Guyana), the district-scale Arakaka project (Barama-Waimi District, NW Guyana), and the Fish Creek project (Barama-Waimi District, NW Guyana). The company has completed over 50,350 m of drilling at Marudi Mountain as of mid-2024, focused on the Mazoa Hill deposit and numerous satellite prospects within the Guiana Shield greenstone belt.

name: Glenstar Minerals Inc.
description: Glenstar Minerals Inc. (formerly Glenstar Ventures Inc., renamed April 7, 2025) is a junior mineral exploration company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia, focused on acquiring and advancing critical mineral properties in Nevada, USA. The company targets polymetallic deposits including nickel, cobalt, copper, zinc, and uranium — metals essential to electrification and renewable energy technologies. Glenstar also trades on the OTCQB (GSTRF) and Frankfurt Stock Exchange (VO20).

name: Getchell Gold Corp.
description: Getchell Gold Corp. is a junior gold exploration company focused on advancing its flagship Fondaway Canyon gold project in Churchill County, Nevada. The company also holds the Dixie Comstock epithermal gold property in Churchill County, which was leased to Montana Goldfields LLC in September 2025. Former exploration-stage properties in Humboldt and Pershing Counties (Hot Springs Peak, Star, and several legacy Buena Vista-era assets) have been relinquished or terminated. A positive Preliminary Economic Assessment was filed for Fondaway Canyon in February 2025, underpinning a 2.86 Moz Au resource (indicated + inferred).

name: Global Uranium Corp.
description: Global Uranium Corp. is a uranium exploration company focused on acquiring and advancing uranium projects in established mining districts. The company holds properties in the Athabasca Basin (Saskatchewan, Canada) and five projects in Wyoming, USA. All properties are at the exploration stage with no NI 43-101 resource estimates as of early 2026.

name: Hi-View Resources Inc.
description: Hi-View Resources Inc. is a publicly listed mineral exploration company advancing a portfolio of gold, silver, and copper assets in the Toodoggone Gold & Copper District of northern British Columbia. The Company's 100%-owned and optioned projects cover more than 27,791 hectares across the Toodoggone region, making it the fifth-largest landholder north of Kemess. Formerly traded as CSE: HVW (changed to GXLD effective January 12, 2026). Also listed on OTCQB: HVWRF and FSE: B63.

name: Greenridge Exploration Inc.
description: Greenridge Exploration Inc. is a Canadian junior exploration company listed on the CSE focused primarily on uranium in the Athabasca Basin and northern Saskatchewan/Nunavut, with additional strategic metals projects in nickel, copper, gold, and lithium across Canada. The company significantly expanded its uranium and nickel portfolio through an all-share acquisition of ALX Resources Corp. in 2024.

name: Silver Hammer Mining Corp
description: Silver Hammer Mining Corp (CSE: HAMR | OTCQB: HAMRF) is a junior exploration company focused on silver and gold in the western United States and British Columbia. Its flagship asset is the Silver Strand Mine in Idaho's Coeur d'Alene Mining District – a past-producing, fully permitted project with Phase I and II diamond drilling completed. The company also holds the Silverton Silver Mine and Eliza Silver Project in Nevada, the recently optioned Fahey Group Project in Idaho's Silver Valley, and the Lacy Gold Project on Vancouver Island, BC.

name: Hercules Resources Corp.
description: Hercules Resources Corp. is an early-stage junior exploration company listed on the CSE (ticker: HERC). The company holds options on copper-gold porphyry and epithermal gold-silver properties across British Columbia (Canada) and Ecuador. As of early 2025, the company completed a 10:1 share consolidation and is in early-stage exploration on all assets. No NI 43-101 technical reports have been filed for any property.

name: First Atlas Resources Corp.
description: First Atlas Resources Corp. (formerly Q Precious & Battery Metals Corp., Q Battery Metals Corp., and Black Tusk Resources Inc.) is a junior exploration company listed on the CSE. The company holds a diversified portfolio of exploration-stage assets in Quebec and Nova Scotia, Canada, spanning gold, copper-zinc VMS, lithium pegmatite, rare earth element, and natural hydrogen targets.

name: Highland Critical Minerals Corp.
description: Highland Critical Minerals Corp. is an early-stage mineral exploration company incorporated in 2023 and headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. The company holds a lithium-focused property in Northwestern Ontario (Church Property) and gold-focused properties in the Kivalliq Region of Nunavut (Sy Property) and the Red Lake Gold Camp of Northwestern Ontario. Gold properties are held via wholly-owned subsidiary Highland Red Lake Gold Corp., which is subject to a planned spin-out arrangement. Nunavut claims are held via wholly-owned subsidiary 6025 Nunavut Ltd. The company listed on the CSE (ticker: HLND) on May 27, 2025 and also trades on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (FSE: U8X). Market cap approximately CAD $4.7 million as at March 2, 2026.

name: HM Exploration Corp.
description: Vancouver-based junior exploration company focused on acquisition and development of copper, zinc, gold and silver mineral projects in Canada. Listed on the CSE on December 6, 2024. Operates three assets: Devil's Den Project (BC), Pilley's Island Project (NL), and Lewis Copper Tenure (NL) — the latter two combined as the Lewis Pilley's Project (~42 km²).

name: Heritage Mining Ltd.
description: Heritage Mining Ltd. is a Canadian junior mineral exploration company advancing multiple high-grade gold and critical mineral projects in Northern Ontario. The Company is listed on the CSE (HML) and the Boerse Frankfurt (Y66). Its flagship Drayton-Black Lake project covers ~18,907 ha in the underexplored Eagle-Wabigoon-Manitou Greenstone Belt near Sioux Lookout, Ontario. Additional properties include Contact Bay (Cu-Ni-PGE), Scattergood, and the recently acquired Melba Mine in the Kirkland Lake district. Management has 100+ combined years of mining and capital markets experience.

name: Highrock Resources Ltd.
description: Highrock Resources Ltd. is a development-stage junior exploration company listed on the CSE in March 2023. The company holds a portfolio of three early-stage mineral properties: the Pathfinder Gold Project (British Columbia, option earn-in), the Dry Creek Uranium Project (Colorado, USA, 100% owned via Liberty Uranium Corporation subsidiary), and the Minnitaki Lake Gold Property (Ontario, option earn-in). No NI 43-101 resource estimates have been defined on any property.

name: High Tide Resources Corp.
description: High Tide Resources Corp. is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on iron ore and battery metals. Its flagship asset is the Labrador West Iron Project in Newfoundland and Labrador, for which a maiden NI 43-101 inferred resource of 655 Mt @ 28.8% Fe was published in February 2023. The company also holds the Lac Pegma Cu-Ni-Co sulphide project in Quebec.

name: Gold Hunter Resources Inc.
description: Gold Hunter Resources Inc. is a junior exploration company focused on the Great Northern Project, a 26,237-hectare district-scale gold exploration property on the Great Northern Peninsula of Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada. The company has consolidated the Viking and Jackson's Arm sub-blocks along the Doucers Valley Fault corridor, which hosts the NI 43-101-compliant Thor Deposit and the historical Rattling Brook Deposit. A fully-funded inaugural drill program of up to 10,000 m is planned for 2026 following completion of a district-wide VTEM airborne survey. Gold Hunter also retains the Cameron Lake East property in Ontario and a 1% NSR royalty on properties sold to Sorrento Resources in 2023. The company also trades on the OTCQB as HNTRF and on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange as 6RH.

name: Headwater Gold Inc.
description: Headwater Gold is a CSE-listed junior gold explorer focused on discovering new low-sulphidation epithermal gold-silver systems in the Walker Lane belt and Great Basin of Nevada, Idaho and Oregon. The company operates a prospect generator / earn-in business model, retaining minority stakes while major partners (Newmont, OceanaGold, Centerra Gold) fund exploration on its flagship projects. As of early 2026, Headwater holds 10 active properties across Nevada and Idaho, none of which carry an NI 43-101 compliant mineral resource estimate.

name: Hertz Energy Inc.
description: Hertz Energy Inc. is a junior exploration company focused on high-grade antimony-silver-zinc and critical minerals projects. Current core assets include the Craig (Crag & Rod) high-grade Ag-Pb-Zn project in Yukon, the Lake George Antimony project in New Brunswick, the Harriman Antimony project in Québec, and the Agastya Lithium project in James Bay, Québec. The company also holds the AC/DC and La Fleur Lithium projects in James Bay. Note: Hertz completed a 4-for-1 share consolidation effective Dec-12-2024 and a 2.5-for-1 consolidation effective Sep-19-2025.

name: Integral Metals Corp.
description: Integral Metals Corp. is a Canadian junior exploration company listed on the CSE. The company holds three active exploration properties: the KAP Property (MVT Zn-Pb-Ga-Ge) in the Northwest Territories, the Burntwood Property (carbonatite-hosted REE) in Manitoba, and the Woods Creek Project (REE carbonatite) in Montana, USA. The company disposed of its former ZigZag lithium property in Ontario in November 2024.

name: Irving Resources Inc.
description: Irving Resources Inc. is a Canadian-based junior mineral exploration company focused on discovering silica-rich gold and silver deposits in Japan. The company holds 100% of its flagship Omu Gold-Silver Project in Hokkaido (subject to a partial farm-in with JX Advanced Metals Corporation), and holds a 27.5% interest in the Yamagano and Noto joint ventures in Kyushu and Honshu, respectively (Newmont 60%, Sumitomo 12.5%). Irving was incorporated in 2015 following a plan of arrangement involving Gold Canyon Resources Inc. and First Mining Finance Corp., and commenced trading on the CSE in December 2015. The company operates through its wholly-owned subsidiary Irving Resources Japan GK, incorporated in May 2016.

name: Inspiration Mining Corp.
description: Inspiration Mining Corp. (CSE: ISP; OTC: ISPNF) is a Vancouver-based junior mineral exploration company focused on gold and copper discovery in Northern Saskatchewan. The Company holds two flagship Rottenstone Domain projects (Rottenstone North and Rottenstone West) totalling ~35,523 ha, positioned immediately adjacent to Ramp Metals' high-grade Rush VMS copper-gold and Ranger gold discoveries. The Company also holds uranium exploration assets in the Athabasca and Thelon Basins and legacy lithium and polymetallic properties in Ontario and British Columbia. Formerly known as Inspiration Energy Corp. (name changed February 25–26, 2026), and prior to that as Rock Edge Resources Ltd. (name changed February 27, 2024). Incorporated 2020, Vancouver BC. ISIN: CA45791Q1000.

name: Kobrea Exploration Corp.
description: Kobrea Exploration Corp. is a CSE-listed junior explorer focused on copper. It holds two core assets: the 100%-owned Upland Copper Project in British Columbia, Canada (a remobilized polymetallic VMS-style copper-silver target with extensive historical drilling) and an exclusive option to earn up to 100% of the seven-property Western Malargüe Copper Projects in Mendoza Province, Argentina (73,334 ha of copper porphyry targets on the southern continuation of the Neogene porphyry belt that hosts El Teniente and Rio Blanco–Los Bronces). The maiden drill campaign at El Perdido (Argentina) commenced in January 2026.

name: Makenita Resources Inc.
description: Makenita Resources Inc. is a junior exploration company listed on the CSE (ticker: KENY), spun out from Cruz Battery Metals Corp. in December 2024. The company holds three properties: the flagship Hector Silver-Cobalt Project in Ontario (100% owned, 2,243 ha), the Sisson West Tungsten Project in New Brunswick (~3,804 ha under option), and the NTX Rare Earth Project in Quebec (~3,642 ha under option). CEO: Jason Gigliotti.

name: KO Gold Inc.
description: KO Gold Inc. is a Canadian exploration company focused on acquiring, exploring, and developing gold mineral properties in the Otago Gold District on the South Island of New Zealand. The company holds interests in nine exploration and prospecting permits totalling over 800 km2 across the Hyde-Macraes Shear Zone (HMSZ) and Carrick Plateau Shear Zone (CPSZ) corridors. KO Gold listed on the CSE on October 11, 2023 under the symbol KOG and is headquartered in Bedford, Nova Scotia.

name: Kuya Silver Corporation
description: Kuya Silver Corporation is a junior silver company with three project pillars: the Bethania Silver Project (Peru), a high-grade epithermal Ag-Pb-Zn mine district with a 2023 NI 43-101 MRE; the Silver Kings Project (Ontario, Canada), a district-scale consolidation of the historic Cobalt silver-cobalt camp; and a minority carried interest in the Umm Hadid silver-gold JV in Saudi Arabia.

name: Kingsview Minerals Ltd.
description: Kingsview Minerals is a Canadian mineral exploration company focused on the acquisition and exploration of gold and base metal properties. Listed on the CSE on February 24, 2022, the Company previously held a portfolio of properties in the Wawa Gold Corridor, Ontario (Echum and Hubcap Projects, sold to BTU Metals Corporation in 2024). The Company's current focus is the Vernon Property in southeastern New Brunswick, a gold-copper exploration target with a history of mining activity dating to the 1860s.

name: La Imperial Resources Inc.
description: La Imperial Resources Inc. is a Canadian junior mining company focused on the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties in Mexico. The company holds a 70% indirect interest in the Uruachi Concessions (13,209 ha) in Chihuahua, Mexico, targeting gold, silver, and industrial metals in the Sierra Madre Occidental epithermal belt. The property has been fully impaired since FY2012 and the company has had no active exploration since that time. Going concern risk noted in all recent MD&As. Incorporated October 4, 2004 under the Canada Business Corporations Act; listed on the CSE December 14, 2007.

name: Lancaster Resources Inc.
description: Lancaster Resources Inc. is a multi-commodity junior explorer focused on gold, uranium, lithium, and polymetallic projects across Australia, Canada, and the USA. The company was formed via the June 2023 reverse takeover of NeonMind Biosciences by Lancaster Lithium Inc. Key assets include the Lake Cargelligo Gold Project in New South Wales (flagship), two uranium properties in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin, a lithium option in James Bay Quebec, a polymetallic project adjacent to Power Metallic's Nisk discovery in James Bay, and a lithium brine project in New Mexico (status uncertain as of early 2026).

name: Leocor Mining Inc.
description: Leocor Mining Inc. (formerly Leocor Gold Inc.; name change effective January 2025) is a junior exploration company focused on gold and base metal projects in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada. The company holds a portfolio of properties in the Baie Verte District (Dorset, Copper Creek, Five Mile Brook) and the Western Exploit District (Robert's Arm, Leamington, Hodge's Hill), plus an earn-in at Startrek (Gander District). Leocor also holds a ~26% strategic equity stake in Intrepid Metals Corp. (TSX.V: INTR), a Cu-Au explorer in Arizona. The company completed its maiden diamond drill campaigns at both Dorset and Copper Creek in 2025, confirming orogenic gold at Dorset (best: 28.5 g/t Au over 0.4m) and a VMS feeder zone at Copper Creek (best: 3.6m of 1.49% Cu).

name: Lion Copper and Gold Corp.
description: Lion Copper and Gold Corp. (formerly Quaterra Resources Inc., renamed November 2021) is a Vancouver-based junior mining company focused on advancing the Yerington Copper Project in Nevada, USA — one of the largest undeveloped copper systems in North America. Core Nevada assets are held through wholly-owned subsidiary Singatse Peak Services LLC (SPS) and are subject to a staged earn-in agreement with Nuton LLC (a Rio Tinto venture) for up to 65% interest in exchange for ~US$50M in exploration investment. The company also holds early-stage exploration properties in British Columbia and, via 42%-owned subsidiary Falcon Copper Corp, holds properties in Montana, Alaska, and Nevada. Additional royalty interests are held through Blue Copper Royalties LLC (48.8% effective).

name: Lexston Mining Corporation
description: Lexston Mining Corporation (CSE: LEXT; OTCQB: LEXTF) is an early-stage mineral exploration company formerly known as Lexston Life Sciences Corp., which completed a Change of Business to mineral exploration in January 2023. The company holds an option on the Dory copper-zinc-gold skarn property on Vancouver Island, BC, and recently acquired an option on the Garfield Hills gold-silver-copper property in Mineral County, Nevada. As of March 2026, Lexston has not completed any drill programs on its properties and holds no NI 43-101 mineral resource or reserve estimates.

name: LaFleur Minerals Inc.
description: LaFleur Minerals Inc. (formerly Quebec Pegmatite Corp.) is a junior gold exploration and development company focused on the Abitibi Greenstone Belt in Québec, Canada. Its flagship asset is the Swanson Gold Project located ~45–66 km north of Val-d'Or, supported by the 100%-owned Beacon Gold Mill and Property near Val-d'Or, which is under care and maintenance with restart planning underway.

name: LFNT Resources Corp.
description: LFNT Resources Corp. (formerly LFNT Capital Corp.) is a Vancouver-based junior explorer listed on the CSE (April 2023). The company holds an option to earn 100% of the Skyfire Property in the Cariboo Mining Division of British Columbia, Canada, targeting polymetallic veins (Ag-Au-Cu-Sb) with additional orogenic gold potential. As of March 2026, the Skyfire option has been extended to December 2026 via an amendment signed December 31 2025. The previously optioned Sudbury Project in Saskatchewan was terminated in September 2024. No drilling has been conducted on any LFNT property to date. Head office: 401–750 West Pender Street, Vancouver, BC V6C 2T7.

name: Lighthouse Gold Inc.
description: Lighthouse Gold Inc. (formerly Alerio Gold Corp., formerly Project One Resources Ltd.) is a Vancouver-based junior gold explorer focused on Guyana. The company holds four gold properties in the Guiana Shield, including the Tassawini Gold Project (historical resource ~499,000 oz Au), Harpy, Puruni, and Aurora NW (under LOI). All properties were fully impaired in August 2024 due to insufficient funds. The company underwent a name change from Alerio Gold Corp. to Lighthouse Gold Inc. effective December 17, 2025, with CSE symbol changing from ALE to LGHT.

name: Libra Energy Materials Inc.
description: Libra Energy Materials Inc. is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on lithium, cesium, tantalum and other critical minerals. Its flagship assets are the KoBold earn-in Kobra Projects in Ontario and Québec, together with a portfolio of Brazilian critical-mineral properties acquired through the September 2025 purchase of Brion Minerals Ltd. The company's Flanders North and South, Soules Bay-Caron, Toivo, Nemiscau and Wegucci properties in Canada are subject to a staged earn-in by KoBold Metals; Brazilian holdings include the Borborema lithium portfolio, Bahia graphite portfolio, Deflinopolis cobalt-nickel, Penelope REE-Ta-Nb and Palmeiropolis lithium projects.

name: Global Li-Ion Graphite Corp.
description: Global Li-Ion Graphite Corp. (CSE: LION) is a junior exploration company focused on graphite and critical minerals. Its flagship asset is the Ambato-Arana Graphite Project in eastern Madagascar, a property with documented historical production. The company also holds a legacy diamond JV interest at Lac de Gras, NWT, and has announced an exclusive MOU to acquire the Montepuez Graphite Project in Mozambique.

name: Live Energy Minerals Corp.
description: Live Energy Minerals Corp. (formerly Gold Tree Resources Ltd.) is a Canadian junior exploration company listed on the CSE. The company holds interests in lithium, uranium and base/precious metal properties in Nevada, Saskatchewan, and New Mexico, held primarily through its wholly owned Nevada subsidiary Lithium Valley Holdings Corp. (LVHC). The flagship McDermitt Lithium East property is located on the eastern margin of the McDermitt Caldera in Nevada, adjacent to Lithium Americas' Thacker Pass project. As at April 2025, the company had 18,220,501 common shares issued and outstanding.

name: Champion Electric Metals Inc.
description: Champion Electric Metals Inc. (formerly Idaho Champion Gold Mines) is a junior exploration company with a portfolio of lithium, gold, silver and cobalt properties across the James Bay region of Quebec and east-central Idaho, USA.

name: Myriad Uranium Corp.
description: Myriad Uranium Corp. is a Canadian uranium exploration company listed on the CSE. Its primary asset is the Copper Mountain Uranium Project in Wyoming, USA (75% interest earned), a large-scale, multi-deposit uranium district with ~C$117M (2024$) in historical exploration. The Company also holds 100% of the Red Basin Uranium-Vanadium Project in New Mexico, USA. Both the Millen Mountain gold property (Nova Scotia, 50% JV with Probe Gold, impaired) and former Niger uranium licences (terminated July 2024) are inactive or relinquished.

name: Manning Ventures Inc.
description: Manning Ventures Inc. is a junior exploration company focused on lithium and copper exploration in Canada and the United States. The company holds a portfolio of early-stage exploration properties including the Bounty Lithium project in the James Bay Pegmatite District of Quebec, the Leaf River lithium district package in northern Quebec, the Copper Hill porphyry-skarn copper project in Nevada's Walker Lane Trend, and the Kaba Copper-Lithium project in NW Ontario.
