The company also retains iron ore properties in the Wabush-Fermont District of Quebec and various polymetallic properties in Newfoundland.

name: Maxus Mining Inc.
description: Maxus Mining Inc. is an early-stage critical mineral exploration company incorporated in British Columbia, Canada (formerly 1475431 B.C. Ltd., renamed January 2025). The company holds a portfolio of five properties in British Columbia targeting antimony, tungsten, copper, gold, and silver. Properties were acquired primarily via option agreements in June 2025. The company also trades on the FWB (R7V) and OTCQB (MXMGF). No drilling has been completed by Maxus on any of its properties as of March 2026; maiden drilling is planned for the 2026 field season at Alturas West, pending VTEM survey interpretation.

name: Max Power Mining Corp.
description: Max Power Mining Corp. is a Canadian junior exploration company listed on the CSE focused on two primary business lines: critical-minerals exploration (lithium claystone/brine and Ni-Co-Cu-PGE) and natural hydrogen exploration (Saskatchewan HAG permit portfolio). The company holds the Willcox Playa Lithium Project in Arizona, a suite of Quebec lithium pegmatite properties, the Nicobat Ni-Co-Cu property in Ontario, natural hydrogen and associated gas (HAG) permits in Saskatchewan, and geological-hydrogen mineral claims in Ontario. The Saskatchewan portfolio, anchored by the Lawson discovery well — reported as Canada's first natural hydrogen drilling discovery — is now the company's leading active business line.

name: Mabel Ventures Inc.
description: Mabel Ventures Inc. is a CSE-listed junior exploration company. Its sole confirmed current mineral property interest is a 51% earn-in interest in the Bonanza Gold Property in Quebec, Canada, held jointly with Abitibi Metals Corp. (49%). The company completed its earn-in in two stages, meeting expenditure and share-issuance milestones in December 2023 and December 2024 respectively. A proposed acquisition of Decade Resources' interests in the Red Cliff and Premier East properties in British Columbia was terminated on September 15, 2025 before closing.

name: McLaren Resources Inc.
description: McLaren Resources Inc. is a junior gold exploration company focused on properties in the Timmins Mining Camp of Northern Ontario, Canada. The company holds three active 100%-owned gold properties — McCool, Blue Quartz, and Kerrs — all located along or proximal to the Destor-Porcupine Deformation Zone (DPDZ), one of the world's most prolific gold-bearing fault systems. The company sold its Augdome Gold Property to Newmont Corporation in August 2024 for $572,889, retaining a 1.0% NSR. McLaren is also listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange under the symbol 3ML.

name: Mustang Energy Corp.
description: Mustang Energy Corp. is a uranium and critical mineral exploration company focused on the Athabasca Basin, Saskatchewan, and Newfoundland & Labrador. Led by CEO Nicholas Luksha and headquartered in Vancouver, BC, the company holds a portfolio of approximately 147,153 hectares across unconformity-type uranium targets in Saskatchewan and grassroots properties in eastern Canada. Three properties (Ford Lake, Roughrider South, Cigar Lake East) were subject to a spinout arrangement to Allied Strategic Resource Corp. as of October 2025 (CSE approval pending). Listed on CSE: MEC, OTC: MECPF, Frankfurt: 92T.

name: Medaro Mining Corp.
description: Medaro Mining Corp. is a junior exploration company focused on critical minerals including rare earth elements, lithium, and uranium. As of early 2026, active projects include the Bastnäs REE-Cu-Au skarn property in Sweden and the Clay Howells West REE carbonatite property in Ontario, Canada. The company also holds Bear Lodge rare earth claims in Wyoming via its wholly owned subsidiary Cascadia Rare Earths. Several former lithium properties in Quebec and Ontario have been discontinued and impaired as of FY2025.

name: MegaWatt Lithium and Battery Metals Corp.
description: MegaWatt Lithium and Battery Metals Corp. (formerly Walcott Resources Ltd.) is a Vancouver-based junior explorer incorporated December 11, 2017 in British Columbia. The company acquires, explores and develops mineral properties targeting battery metals (lithium, cobalt), uranium, REE, and silver across Canada and Australia. Also listed on FSE (WR20) and OTCQB (WALRF).

name: Cameo Resources Inc.
description: Cameo Resources Inc. is a junior mineral exploration company incorporated in British Columbia, Canada, focused on gold exploration in Tanzania (Geita Region) and lithium exploration in Nevada, USA. The company holds two contiguous gold properties in the Sukumaland Greenstone Belt of Tanzania (Katoro and Kempton), located on the same Rwamagaza Shear Zone structural trend as TRX Gold's producing Buckreef Gold Mine ~15–20 km to the northeast. The company also holds lithium claims (Bonnie Claire East) at the southern end of the Sarcobatus Valley lithium trend in Nevada. Cameo listed on the CSE in 2024 and on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (Z88) in April 2025. First-ever drilling at Katoro was initiated in February 2026 targeting 10–15 holes in 2 of 5 IP+mag-defined mineralized zones.

name: Mercado Minerals Ltd.
description: Mercado Minerals Ltd. (formerly Heartfield Mining Corp.) is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on silver-gold exploration in the Western Sierra Madre Occidental of Sinaloa, Mexico. Its flagship Copalito project hosts four known epithermal silver-gold vein systems tested by 81 historical drill holes (2020–2021), and its inaugural 3,000 m drill program commenced March 10, 2026. The company also holds the early-stage Zamora silver-gold project (~378 ha granted, up to 3,377 ha total) and a legacy option on the Porter Property in British Columbia.

name: Military Metals Corp.
description: Military Metals Corp. is a junior exploration company focused on antimony and critical minerals. The company holds six mineral properties across Slovakia (EU), Nova Scotia (Canada), Saskatchewan (Canada), and Nevada (USA), positioning itself as a multi-jurisdiction antimony-gold explorer with brownfield and past-producing assets.

name: Minera IRL Limited
description: Minera IRL Limited is a Latin America-focused gold mining company with its flagship Corihuarmi Gold Mine in Peru and the advanced Ollachea Gold Project in the Puno Region of Peru. The company also holds the Bethania porphyry exploration project and the Chantal prospect within its Corihuarmi concession block. Minera IRL also trades on the BVL (Lima) and FWB (Frankfurt) exchanges. Note: company has been subject to a Failure to File Cease Trade Order since April 2025.

name: Mayo Lake Minerals Inc.
description: Mayo Lake Minerals Inc. is a Yukon-focused junior exploration company with three active properties (Carlin-Roop, Anderson-Davidson, Edmonton) in the Mayo Mining District, all within the Mayo-Keno segment of the Tombstone Gold Belt. The company targets high-grade Keno Hill Style silver mineralization at Carlin-Roop and Intrusion-Related Gold Systems (IRGS) at Anderson-Davidson and Edmonton. Trail-Minto was sold to Banyan Gold Corp. in December 2025 for C$1,000,000; Mayo retains a 2% NSR. No NI 43-101 mineral resource estimates have been published as of March 2026.

name: McFarlane Lake Mining Limited
description: McFarlane Lake Mining Limited is a Canadian junior gold exploration company focused on its flagship Juby Gold Project in Ontario, a large intrusive-hosted bulk-tonnage gold system with a current NI 43-101 resource of over 4.18 Moz (Indicated + Inferred). The company also holds the McMillan Mine and adjacent Mongowin properties in the Huronian Gold Belt near Espanola, Ontario, plus the Michaud and Munro exploration properties in the Matheson area. High Lake and West Hawk Lake (both formerly held) were sold to Total Metals Corp. in October 2025.

name: Maximus Metals Inc.
description: Junior mineral exploration company engaged in the acquisition, exploration, and evaluation of gold-silver resource properties in British Columbia. Listed on CSE on February 6, 2026.

name: Miata Metals Corp.
description: Miata Metals Corp. is a junior gold explorer focused on district-scale orogenic gold projects in Suriname (Guiana Shield) and British Columbia, Canada. The company holds 70% interests (with options to earn 100%) in the Sela Creek and Nassau Gold Projects in Suriname, and an option to earn 100% of the Cabin Lake polymetallic property in BC. The flagship Sela Creek project has completed a maiden 10,041 m drill program (2025) and commenced a fully-funded 25,000 m follow-up program in 2026. Miata also trades on the OTCQX market.

name: Mongoose Mining Ltd.
description:
Mongoose Mining Ltd. is a junior exploration company focused on IOCG (Iron Oxide Copper-Gold Cobalt)
    mineralisation in Atlantic Canada, primarily Nova Scotia and New Brunswick. Properties are held through wholly-owned
    subsidiary Spark Minerals Inc. (NS) and directly (NB). In December 2025, the board approved a strategic pivot to
    also evaluate properties for natural geologic hydrogen potential while retaining all mineral tenure. CEO and
    qualified person: Terence (Terry) F. Coughlan, P.Geo., co-founder of Gammon Lake Resources and GoGold Resources.
    HQ: Toronto / Halifax, Canada.

name: Mosaic Minerals Corp.
description: Mosaic Minerals Corp. is a Quebec-focused junior explorer that has pivoted from lithium to gold and nickel. Its active portfolio consists of the Golden Island gold project (earn-in option, 25% acquired Dec 2025), the Amanda Gold project (100% owned, James Bay), and the Gaboury Nickel project (100% owned, Témiscamingue). The company also retains 100% of the Lichen and 113 North projects. All lithium properties in the James Bay region were abandoned by April 2025.

name: Molten Metals Corp.
description: Molten Metals Corp. is a junior mineral exploration company focused on critical metals and precious metals across Canada. Current projects include the Senneterre West Gold Project (Quebec), Ticktock Property (British Columbia Golden Triangle), and the Gathering Lake and Triangle Lake lithium pegmatite projects (Ontario), and the Texas polymetallic property (British Columbia). The company previously held antimony-gold assets in Nova Scotia and Slovakia, which were divested in 2024.

name: Global Tactical Metals Corp.
description: Global Tactical Metals Corp. (formerly Cumberland Resources Nickel Corp. / Global Defence Metals Corp.) is a junior exploration company listed on the CSE (MONI) and FSE (A7F), headquartered in Vancouver, BC. The company has pivoted to critical minerals with a focus on antimony and tungsten across properties in Ontario, Newfoundland, British Columbia, and Nevada (USA). No NI 43-101 technical reports have been filed on any current properties as at March 2026. The company has no reported drill programs on any of its current properties.

name: Metalsource Mining Inc.
description: Metalsource Mining Inc. (formerly Silverfish Resources Inc., renamed January 2024) is a junior exploration company listed on the CSE. The company holds option interests in the Silver Hill and Byrd-Pilot VMS/porphyry projects in North Carolina, USA (optioned from Goldstrike Minerals LLC, Oct 2025), the Aruba Ni-Cu-PGE-Mn project in Botswana (100% owned via Red Ridge Mining Pty Ltd subsidiary, acquired Sep 2023), and the Old Timer polymetallic vein property in British Columbia, Canada (option from Rockland Resources Ltd, Dec 2021 – current status uncertain post-Sep 2025). A fifth property, Eastmain (Quebec), held during the Silverfish era, is believed to have lapsed.

name: Meta Critical Minerals Inc.
description: Meta Critical Minerals Inc. (formerly Troy Minerals Inc.; name changed 2026-01-29) is a Canadian junior exploration company listed on the CSE (MTTA), OTCQB (TROYF), and FSE (VJ3). The company holds a diversified portfolio of critical mineral projects including high-purity silica (British Columbia and Mongolia), rare earth elements (Quebec), and a vanadium-titanium-iron-PGE-scandium project (Wyoming, USA).

name: Montego Resources Inc.
description: Montego Resources Inc. is a junior mineral exploration company listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange. The company holds two current mineral properties: the Black Dog Gold Project in northern Quebec and the Black Beard (Black Bear) copper project on the Bonavista Peninsula of Newfoundland. The company has historically held interests in the Kiyuk Lake gold property in Nunavut (divested 2017), the Taylor Silver Project in Nevada (option terminated 2020), the Orogrande Gold Project in Idaho (2018 acquisition; current status unconfirmed), and the Redtop Sunrise Group in British Columbia (impaired 2017).

name: NatBridge Resources Ltd.
description: NatBridge Resources Ltd. (formerly Great Eagle Gold Corp. / GEGC until 2025-06-20; formerly Miza II Resources Inc. until July 2023) is a British Columbia-incorporated junior mining company focused on the acquisition and advancement of NI 43-101-compliant gold resource properties to supply the NatGold Digital blockchain-based digital gold tokenization ecosystem. Under a 5-year supply agreement through 2030, NatBridge retains approximately 73% of gross token-minting value from tokenized resources. Listed CSE: NATB | OTCID: NATBF | FSE: GI80. Head office: Suite 501, 3292 Production Way, Burnaby, BC V5A 4R4. CEO: Stephen Moses; CFO/Director: Michael Moses; Executive Chair: Michelle Ash. QP: Lawrence Segerstrom, CPG. NOTE: BCSC Cease Trade Order issued December 4, 2025 (company engaged BCSC; supplemental NI 43-101 technical report in preparation as at March 2026).

name: North Atlantic Titanium Corp.
description: North Atlantic Titanium Corp. (formerly Muzhu Mining Ltd., name change effective January 5, 2026) is a junior exploration company focused on titanium and polymetallic mineral assets. Its primary focus is the Everett Titanium Property in Quebec, adjacent to Rio Tinto's world-class Lac Tio ilmenite mine. The company also holds the Sleeping Giant South gold-polymetallic property in Quebec and maintains exploration-stage agreements on several properties in Henan Province, China.

name: New Break Resources Ltd.
description: New Break Resources is a junior gold exploration company focused on its flagship Moray Gold Project in the southern Abitibi greenstone belt of Ontario, Canada. The company also retains a residual 20% carried interest in the Sundog Gold Project in Nunavut following its April 2025 sale to Guardian Exploration Inc.

name: Newfoundland Discovery Corp.
description: Newfoundland Discovery Corp. (formerly Great Thunder Gold Corp.; name changed Sep 29, 2021) is a Canadian junior exploration company headquartered in Vancouver, BC. The company holds gold exploration properties in the Central Newfoundland Gold Belt (Exploits Subzone), lithium exploration properties in the Quetico Subprovince of Northwestern Ontario (flagship Sugaree project), and gold exploration properties in the Abitibi Greenstone Belt of Quebec. The company was originally incorporated in 1977. It also trades as OTC: NEWDF and FSE: M4K.

name: Nexus Uranium Corp.
description: Nexus Uranium Corp. is a uranium-focused junior exploration company listed on the CSE. Its core portfolio consists of sandstone-hosted roll-front uranium projects in the Edgemont district of South Dakota and Great Divide Basin of Wyoming, USA, plus an earn-in option on the unconformity-style Mann Lake uranium project in the eastern Athabasca Basin, Saskatchewan. The company was formed through an arrangement with Basin Uranium Corp. in 2025 and acquired 100% of its flagship Chord Uranium Project (NI 43-101 inferred resource of 2.754 Mlb eU3O8) in January 2026.

name: Nexcel Metals Corp.
description:
Nexcel Metals Corp. is a Vancouver-based junior explorer incorporated April 30, 2024,
      focused on critical and strategic metals. The company holds two properties: the Lac Ducharme
      Light Rare Earth Element (LREE) Project in Québec (option toward 100%) and the Burnt Hill
      Tungsten-Molybdenum-Tin Project in New Brunswick (71.58% interest as of February 2026).
      Also listed on OTCQB as NXXCF and on FSE as 2OH.

name: Class 1 Nickel and Technologies Limited
description: Canadian nickel-focused exploration and development company advancing the Alexo-Dundonald nickel sulphide project in Ontario, the Somanike nickel-copper-PGE project in Quebec, and the River Valley PGE-Cu-Ni project in Ontario.

name: Nine Mile Metals Ltd.
description: Nine Mile Metals Ltd. (CSE: NINE | OTC: VMSXF | FSE: KQ9) is a Canadian public mineral exploration company focused on VMS (Cu, Pb, Zn, Ag, Au) exploration in the world-famous Bathurst Mining Camp (BMC), New Brunswick, Canada. The company holds four VMS projects: Nine Mile Brook, California Lake, Canoe Landing Lake (East-West), and Wedge, totalling approximately 136 km² across 624 claims. Nine Mile is focused on Critical Minerals Exploration (CME) positioning for the boom in EV and green technologies requiring copper, silver, lead and zinc.

name: North American Niobium and Critical Minerals Corp.
description: North American Niobium and Critical Minerals Corp. (formerly First American Uranium Inc.; previously Prosperity Exploration Corp.) is a CSE-listed junior exploration company focused on niobium and rare earth element (REE) critical minerals. The company holds a 29,936-ha district-scale land package of 519 mineral claims across five properties in the Grenville Province of Quebec (Seigneurie, Seagull, Sabot, Blanchette, Bardy), plus the newly-staked Miskam property (~4,222 ha / 73 claims, staked March 2026), and two legacy properties: Silver Lake (Au/base metals, Omineca Mining Division, BC) and Red Basin (U/V, Catron County, NM). A C$2.69M 2026 Quebec exploration program is underway, including a 6,000 m inaugural diamond-drill campaign pending ATI permit approvals.

name: NorthX Nickel Corp.
description: NorthX Nickel Corp. (formerly Archer Exploration Corp.) is a Canadian junior nickel exploration company focused on advancing the Grasset Nickel-Copper-Cobalt-PGM deposit in James Bay, Quebec. The company acquired its flagship nickel assets from Wallbridge Mining in November 2022 via an all-share transaction. NorthX completed a name change and 6:1 share consolidation on May 1, 2024 and sold its 37+ Ontario Sudbury Basin properties to Magna Mining Inc. in July 2025 to focus exclusively on its Quebec nickel portfolio. Wallbridge Mining retains a 2% NSR royalty on the Grasset Project and approximately 19.9% of NorthX shares.

name: Northern Lights Resources Corp.
description: Northern Lights Resources Corp. is a junior mineral exploration company listed on the CSE focused on copper and gold projects in North America. Its active exploration portfolio consists of the Secret Pass Gold Project in Arizona (100% owned, epithermal gold), the Horetzky Copper Project in the Babine Porphyry Belt of British Columbia (option to earn 100%), and the Pup Copper Project near Dawson City, Yukon (option to earn 100%). The company also retains a 1% NSR royalty on the Medicine Springs Silver Project in Nevada following Torex Gold Resources completing its full option in March 2026.

name: Norsemont Mining Inc.
description: Norsemont Mining Inc. is a Canadian junior mining company focused on advancing the Choquelimpie Au-Ag-Cu project in northern Chile — a past-producing, advanced-stage exploration and development asset with a 2025 NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate of 2,184,000 oz AuEq Indicated and 557,000 oz AuEq Inferred.

name: Nevada Organic Phosphate Inc.
description: Nevada Organic Phosphate Inc. (formerly Silver Eagle Mines Inc.) is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on sedimentary rock phosphate in NE Nevada. Its flagship Murdock Mountain / Leach Mountains Project covers 7,824 acres (3,166 ha) in Elko County, Nevada, and is the only known large-scale organic sedimentary phosphate project in North America. The company also trades on the OTCQB under the symbol NOPFF. Property is held through a subsidiary chain: NOP Inc. (BC, Canada) → Nevada Phosphate Inc. (NV corp) → Nevagro LLC (NV LLC), the BLM permit holder.

name: NovaRed Mining Inc.
description: NovaRed Mining Inc. (formerly Rumble Resources Inc., renamed February 11, 2026; formerly Rumble Capital Corp. prior to December 2020) is a Vancouver-based junior mining company focused on the identification, acquisition, exploration, and development of copper-gold porphyry mineral projects in British Columbia, Canada. Its primary asset is the Wilmac Copper-Gold Project (11,504 ha; 70% option), located ~10 km west of Hudbay Minerals' Copper Mountain Mine in the Similkameen Mining Division. The company also holds an option on the Woolford Creek Silver-Gold Project (~3,620 ha) in the Kamloops Mining Division. CEO: Brian Goss. OTC symbol: NREDF. Incorporated 2017.

name: Northstar Gold Corp.
description: Northstar Gold Corp. is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on advanced-stage gold and copper projects in Ontario. Its flagship Miller Copper-Gold Property (incl. Allied Gold Zone and Cam Copper Mine) is located 18 km SE of Kirkland Lake in the Pacaud Township, targeting alkalic intrusion-hosted gold-telluride and high-grade VMS copper mineralization. The company also holds the Rosegrove, Searles, Bryce Gold, and Milestone Cu-Ni-Co properties, all in Ontario. Northstar listed on the CSE via IPO on January 2, 2020.

name: NSJ Gold Corp.
description: NSJ Gold Corp. is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on gold and critical mineral projects. Its primary asset is the Golden Hills Project, a gold-copper-iron exploration property in La Paz County, Arizona, USA. In July 2025, NSJ also optioned the Antimony 2.0 Property in New Brunswick, Canada, targeting antimony mineralization analogous to the historic Lake George Antimony Mine.

name: Newterra Resources Inc.
description: Newterra Resources Inc. is a CSE-listed junior mineral exploration company focused on gold in British Columbia and Ontario. Its principal asset is the 100%-owned Iron Horse Project (Au-Cu-Zn skarn/vein, Okanagan region, BC), complemented by two recently optioned early-stage gold properties in the Red Lake Mining District of Ontario: the Ferdinand Gold Property and the Willans Gold Property.

name: Nuclear Vision Limited
description: Nuclear Vision Limited (formerly Gold Digger Resources Inc., CSE: GDIG; name changed May 16, 2025) is a Vancouver-based junior explorer focused on uranium and battery minerals. Its primary asset is the UA92 Uranium Project in Botswana (~4,828 km² across 7 prospecting licenses in the Karoo Basin), targeting ISR-style sandstone-hosted uranium analogous to Lotus Resources' adjacent Letlhakane deposit. The company also holds an early-stage gold exploration property in Québec (Regnault Project) and signed definitive agreements in January 2026 to acquire two historical manganese carbonate projects in Slovakia's EU Battery Belt (Svabovce and Michalova). A C$6M private placement was closed February 6, 2026 with anchor participation from Eric Sprott. No drilling has been conducted by the company on any current property as at March 2026.

name: Nova Pacific Metals Corp.
description: Nova Pacific Metals Corp. is a junior exploration company focused on its flagship Expanded Lara VMS Project on southern Vancouver Island, British Columbia. The project covers a 17 km belt of McLaughlin Ridge Formation stratigraphy hosting Kuroko-type polymetallic VMS mineralization with Au-Ag-Zn-Cu-Pb. The company completed a 41-hole / 8,660 m Phase 1 drill program in 2025 and is advancing the project toward an updated NI 43-101 resource estimate.

name: North Valley Resources Ltd.
description: North Valley Resources Ltd. is a British Columbia-focused mineral exploration company listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange. The company holds option agreements on two properties in the Nicola and Kamloops Mining Districts of southern B.C.: the flagship Comstock Copper-Gold Property (~4,462 ha, adjacent to Coquihalla Highway south of Merritt) and the Barnum Property (~266 ha, east of Kamloops). As of early 2026, the Comstock property is an active exploration-stage asset with a 100-hole drill permit in hand; Barnum remains under legal option but has been written down to nil and no further exploration is planned.

name: Nuinsco Resources Limited
description: Nuinsco Resources Limited is a Canadian junior explorer focused on critical minerals and gold. Its flagship asset is the 100%-owned Prairie Lake Critical Minerals and Phosphate Project in Ontario, hosting one of North America's largest carbonatite-hosted REE-Nb-P deposits by tonnage (NI 43-101 MRE, P&E Mining Consultants, 2022). The company also holds royalty interests in the Sunbeam Gold and Zigzag Lake properties optioned to First Class Metals PLC, and is pursuing international arbitration against Egypt over its El Sid gold tailings project under the Canada-Egypt Bilateral Investment Treaty.

name: Nexco Resources Inc.
description: Nexco Resources Inc. is a British Columbia-incorporated mineral resource company engaged in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral resource properties in Canada. Its sole mineral property is the Berger-Golden Eagle Mineral Property located in the Kamloops Mining District of south-central British Columbia. The company is listed on the CSE but has been designated inactive (NXU.X suffix) and trading is suspended as of March 2026. Nexco also disclosed development of a proprietary mining explosives technology product line. A proposed acquisition of Soter Technologies LLC (and its SymptomSense subsidiary) was announced via Definitive Agreement in May 2021; the outcome of that transaction has not been confirmed in public sources.

name: Omega Pacific Resources Inc.
description: Omega Pacific Resources Inc. is a junior mineral exploration company incorporated June 3, 2022 under the BC Business Corporations Act. The company is focused on its 100%-owned Williams Property in the Toodoggone District of British Columbia, Canada — a Au-Cu epithermal/porphyry exploration project situated in the Golden Horseshoe corridor between the Red Chris Mine and Kemess North deposit. Also trades on OTCQB: OMGPF and FSE: Q0F. CEO: Jason Leikam. QP: Robert L'Heureux, P.Geol.

name: Gold Orogen Resources Corp.
description: Early-stage pure-play gold exploration company with assets in the Yukon Tombstone Belt and the Appalachian/Iapetus Gold Belt in New Brunswick, Canada. Spun out from Lode Gold Resources Inc. (TSXV: LOD) via RTO of Great Republic Mining (CSE: GRM) effective February 18, 2026. Strategic partner Fancamp Exploration Ltd. (TSXV: FNC) holds 19.9% of Gold Orogen and invested $3.5M in August 2024.

name: One World Lithium Inc.
description: One World Lithium Inc. (CSE: OWLI | OTCQB: OWRDF) is a Vancouver-based technology-stage company focused on commercialising its proprietary Direct Lithium Carbonate Extraction (DLCE) technology. Incorporated in British Columbia in 1982 (originally as One World Investments Inc.), the company pivoted to mineral exploration in 2017, acquiring options on the Salar del Diablo lithium brine project in Baja California, Mexico and the Mogollon silver-gold project in New Mexico, USA. Both mineral properties were subsequently terminated (Mogollon in June 2018; Salar del Diablo in May 2022 following negative drill results). As of 2022 the company has operated solely as a lithium extraction technology company. OWL owns two USPTO-assigned patent applications for its DLCE process (assigned November 2024, developed with MatterGreen LLC of Albany, Oregon) and held a non-exclusive Research and Evaluation License with the US Department of Energy / NETL (signed March 2022; last extended to March 1, 2025). Bench-scale validation of the DLCE technology was completed November 2023. Market cap approximately C$3.1 million (August 2025). A Management Cease Trade Order was issued May 1, 2025 for late filings.

name: Newpath Resources Inc.
description: Newpath Resources Inc. (formerly Ready Set Gold Corp., renamed Dec 8, 2022) is a junior explorer focused on gold and critical metals in Ontario, Canada. Its flagship Northshore Gold Project (Thunder Bay Mining Division) hosts a NI 43-101 pit-constrained inferred resource of 240,100 oz Au. The company is pivoting focus toward its large Orefield lithium (LCT pegmatite) land package near the Nipigon Lithium District, comprising the Alpha/Bravo (~63,968 Ha), Charlie, and Delta claim groups, plus the newly optioned Pat Ann Claims. An LOI to sell the Northshore patented claims to Great Eagle Gold Corp. for CDN$1,000,000 was signed January 2025.

name: Provenance Gold Corp
description: Provenance Gold Corp (CSE: PAU | OTCQB: PVGDF) is a junior gold exploration company focused on advancing a portfolio of gold and silver properties in Oregon and Nevada, USA. Its flagship Eldorado West project in Malheur County, Oregon is a large porphyry gold system with active drilling, hosting a historical (non-NI 43-101) estimate of ~1.98 Moz Au. The company is also advancing Eldorado East, White Rock (Nevada), Silver Bow (Nevada), and Mineral Hill (Nevada).

name: Pegmatite One Lithium and Gold Corp.
description: Pegmatite One Lithium and Gold Corp. (formerly Madi Minerals Ltd., name changed January 2023) is a junior exploration company focused on lithium and gold properties in Ontario and British Columbia, Canada. Its flagship lithium assets — the Frazer Lake-Mound and Morrison River properties in northwestern Ontario — were subject to option agreements with ASX-listed Valor Resources Ltd. (ASX: VAL). The company also holds the Dort gold property in north-central BC (100% option) and the Georgina gold property on Vancouver Island, BC (75% interest).

name: Patriot Gold Corp.
description: Patriot Gold Corp. is a Nevada/Arizona-focused gold royalty and exploration company listed on the CSE and OTC markets. The company holds two producing/advanced royalty interests (Moss Mine 3% NSR; Bruner Gold 2% NSR) and three wholly-owned exploration properties in Nevada (Windy Peak, Thra, and Vernal). Patriot has received ~$11M USD in royalty revenues from the Moss Mine to date. The company's flagship exploration asset is the Windy Peak Gold Project in Churchill County, Nevada, where four drill programs have confirmed low-sulfidation epithermal Au mineralization along a 2.7-mile strike.

name: Planet Green Metals Inc.
description: Planet Green Metals Inc. (formerly Forza Lithium Corp., renamed April 2024) is a Canadian junior exploration company listed on the CSE. The company holds a portfolio of six exploration properties in Ontario, Canada targeting VMS copper-zinc-silver, orogenic gold, and LCT lithium-cesium-tantalum pegmatite mineralization. Flagship asset is the Sheraton VMS Property (~3,091 ha, expandable to ~13,228 ha with Kraken option) located 40 km east-southeast of Timmins in the Wawa-Abitibi Greenstone Belt. The company was formed via the April 2024 merger of Forza Lithium Corp. (CSE: FZ) and the private Planet Green Metals Ltd., combining the Jeannette and Harrison Road lithium assets with four new Ontario gold/VMS/lithium properties optioned from Gravel Ridge Resources Ltd. Headquartered in British Columbia, Canada. Financial year-end: October 31.

name: First Phosphate Corp.
description: First Phosphate Corp. is a Canadian junior mining company focused on the development of high-purity igneous phosphate deposits in the Saguenay-Lac-St-Jean (SLSJ) region of Quebec. Formerly First Potash Corp. (name changed June 29, 2022), the company holds 100% royalty-free interests in all its properties, which are hosted within the Lac-Saint-Jean Anorthosite Suite (LSJAS). Its flagship Bégin-Lamarche project has a PEA-stage NI 43-101 resource and a completed Preliminary Economic Assessment (Dec 2024) targeting LFP battery-grade phosphate production. Also trades on OTCQX as FRSPF and FSE as KD0.

name: Forty Pillars Mining Corp.
description: Forty Pillars Mining Corp. is a mineral exploration company incorporated in British Columbia (February 4, 2021) and listed on the CSE (May 31, 2021). The company focuses on gold, silver, lead, zinc, and copper exploration across Canada. Its flagship asset is the Silver Dollar Project in British Columbia. Additional active properties include the Beatrice Mineral Property (BC), Quebec Claims (QC), Val-d'Or North Property (QC, option), and Golden Link Project (NL, option). No drill programs have been conducted by Forty Pillars to date; all historical production and assay data are from prior operators.

name: Pluto Ventures Inc.
description: Pluto Ventures Inc. is a British Columbia exploration-stage company (incorporated September 8, 2021) listed on the CSE (October 30, 2024). The company holds option agreements to earn 100% interests in two properties: the Dardanelle Project (polymetallic epithermal Au-Ag-Cu-Pb-Zn, BC – flagship) and the Monarch Uranium Project (unconformity-style U3O8, Nunavut). No NI 43-101 resource estimates have been published on either property as of March 2026. Head office: Suite 2250, 1055 West Hastings Street, Vancouver, BC V6E 2E9.

name: Powermax Minerals Inc.
description: Powermax Minerals Inc. is an early-stage CSE-listed exploration company focused on rare earth element (REE) projects in Canada and the United States. The company holds option agreements or outright ownership in four properties: Cameron REE (BC), Atikokan REE (ON), Pinard REE (ON), and Ogden Bear Lodge REE (WY, USA). All properties are at the surface exploration stage with no mineral resources or reserves defined as of March 2026. QP: Afzaal Pirzada, P.Geo. (Director).

name: Peloton Minerals Corporation
description: Mineral exploration company focused on large-scale deposits in US jurisdictions with a history of hosting large-scale deposits. Primary focus: lithium, critical minerals, and REE (North Elko Lithium Project, Nevada); secondary focus: gold (Nevada); non-controlling interest (~18%) in a copper porphyry (Montana, via Celerity Mineral Corporation). Incorporated 2000 as Montana Gold Mining Company Inc.; renamed Peloton Minerals Corporation in 2016. Listed on CSE (PMC) and OTC QB (PMCCF). 152,567,062 shares issued and outstanding as of March 13, 2026.

name: Loyalist Exploration Limited
description: Loyalist Exploration Limited is a junior gold exploration company focused on the Timmins Mining District of Ontario, Canada. The company holds four active properties — Tully, DeSantis, Loveland, and Gold Rush — all situated within the Abitibi Greenstone Belt along or near the Destor-Porcupine Deformation Zone. As of early 2026, Loyalist has not conducted its own drilling programs; the company is advancing a portfolio of historically explored properties towards NI 43-101 resource estimates and new exploration campaigns.

name: Pan American Energy Corp.
description: Pan American Energy Corp. is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on critical minerals. Its flagship asset is the Big Mack Lithium Project (LCT pegmatites, Ontario), with an active option on the Tharsis rare earth / niobium project (Northwest Territories). The company previously held the Horizon Lithium Project (Nevada claystone, option terminated August 2024) and spun out the Green Energy Lithium Project (Utah brine) to Legacy Lithium Corp. in April 2023.

name: POWR Lithium Corp.
description: POWR Lithium Corp. (formerly Clear Sky Lithium Corp., renamed January 2023) is a mineral exploration and development company focused on advancing North American lithium and uranium deposits to support domestic energy generation and storage. The company holds a 100% interest in the ELi sediment-hosted lithium project in Nevada and an option to acquire 100% of the Laroque Lake uranium project in Saskatchewan, Canada.

name: Precore Gold Corp.
description: Precore Gold Corp. (formerly Double Deuce Exploration Corp.; name change effective March 19, 2025) is a junior exploration company listed on the CSE. The company holds three properties: the Kimber Property (BC, Canada; base metals), the Lac Big-Rush Property (Quebec, Canada; gold), and the Arikepay Project (Arequipa, Peru; porphyry Cu-Au-Ag). No NI 43-101 compliant resource estimates exist for any current property.

name: Prismo Metals Inc.
description: Prismo Metals is a junior explorer focused on precious and base metal discovery in Mexico and the Arizona Copper Belt (USA). The company's current active portfolio consists of the Palos Verdes epithermal Ag-Au vein project in Sinaloa, Mexico, and two optioned historic high-grade mines in Arizona — Silver King and Ripsey. Hot Breccia (Arizona) was assigned to Blade Resources in March 2026; Prismo retains ~24% equity in Blade and board/participation rights. The former Los Pavitos Au-Ag project in Sonora, Mexico was terminated in fiscal 2025.

name: Prince Silver Corp.
description:
Prince Silver Corp. (formerly Hawthorn Resources Corp., renamed 2025-07-10) is a junior
      exploration company focused on polymetallic silver-gold projects in Nevada, USA. Its flagship
      Prince Silver Project lies within the historic Pioche Mining District, Lincoln County, Nevada,
      approximately 3 km southwest of the town of Pioche. The company also holds the district-scale
      Stampede Gap Cu-Au-Mo porphyry project roughly 15 km north-northwest of the Prince Silver
      Project. Both Nevada assets were acquired through the July 2025 purchase of Stampede Metals
      Corporation. A former option on the Broken Handle Project in British Columbia was relinquished
      effective September 29, 2025.

name: Prospect Ridge Resources Corp.
description: Prospect Ridge Resources Corp. is a British Columbia-focused junior explorer incorporated in 2020, targeting alkalic Cu-Au porphyry and polymetallic vein systems. Its flagship Camelot project (Cariboo Mining District, BC) yielded a copper-gold porphyry discovery in January 2026. The company also holds the Knauss Creek and Holy Grail polymetallic properties near Terrace, BC, and the Castle and Excalibur porphyry projects in north-central and central BC respectively. As of March 2026 PRR holds 100% of Camelot (earn-in completed), 100% of Knauss Creek and Holy Grail, and is earning-in to 100% of Castle and Excalibur. No NI 43-101 mineral resource has been defined on any property to date. Also listed OTC: PRRSF.

name: Pasinex Resources Limited
description: Pasinex Resources Limited is a Canadian junior mining company focused on zinc production and exploration. Its flagship asset is the 100%-owned Pinargozu (Pinargözü) Zinc Mine in Adana Province, Turkey — a high-grade direct shipping ore (DSO) zinc producer on the 80 km Horzum Zinc Trend (HZT). The company also holds the Akkaya Zinc Property (adjacent to Pinargozu), the development-stage Sarıkaya Zinc Project in Kayseri Province, and a 51% earn-in interest in the Gunman Zinc Project in White Pine County, Nevada. All Turkish operations are conducted through wholly owned subsidiary Pasinex Arama ve Madencilik AŞ and its subsidiary Horzum AŞ.

name: Pacifica Silver Corp.
description: Pacifica Silver Corp. (formerly Roberto Resources Inc., CSE: RBTO until July 18 2025) is a Vancouver-based junior explorer focused on silver-gold exploration in Mexico and Peru. The company's flagship Claudia Silver-Gold Project (11,876 ha, Durango, Mexico) hosts a 11 km horsetail vein complex with 12+ named epithermal low-sulphidation veins, acquired from Durango Gold Corp. in July 2025. The company also holds an option to acquire 100% of the Janampalla Property (2,800 ha, Huancavalica, Peru), a copper-silver-gold-lead manto-style vein target at early exploration stage. Incorporated in BC, Canada in 2019; CSE-listed September 4 2024. Also trades on OTCQB (PAGFF) and Frankfurt (RM2.F / WKN A40MYT).

name: Panther Minerals Inc.
description: Panther Minerals Inc. is a Canadian junior exploration company listed on the CSE. The company has evolved through prior names Gold Lion Resources Inc. and Lithium Lion Metals Inc. As of early 2026, its core project is the East Brouillan polymetallic VMS and gold property in Quebec, acquired January 2025, with a proposed lithium-tantalum-cesium pegmatite acquisition (Rubidium Ridge, Ontario) pending closing. The company previously held uranium assets in Alaska and Nevada, legacy gold properties in Idaho and British Columbia, and battery-metal properties in Saskatchewan and Quebec, all of which have been disposed of or abandoned.

name: Quarterback Resources Inc.
description: Quarterback Resources Inc. (CSE: QB, FSE: H89) is a junior exploration company incorporated in 2024 and listed on the CSE on June 13, 2025. The Company holds an exclusive option to acquire 100% of the Twin Gold Project in the Omineca Mining Division, British Columbia. CEO/President: Jigang (Alex) He.

name: Quantum Battery Metals Corp.
description: Quantum Battery Metals Corp. (formerly Quantum Cobalt Corp.) is a CSE-listed junior explorer focused on battery and critical metals. The company holds a portfolio of cobalt-silver-nickel properties in the historic Cobalt camp of Ontario, lithium properties in the James Bay region of Quebec, and copper properties in Newfoundland and Labrador. The company was previously known as Bravura Ventures Corp. and has held assets in the Yukon and Idaho historically.

name: Quimbaya Gold Inc.
description: Quimbaya Gold Inc. is a junior gold explorer focused on building a high-impact exploration portfolio in Colombia's prolific Antioquia gold camp. The company holds three 100%-owned projects — Tahami, Berrio, and Maitamac — totalling approximately 66,000+ Ha in the Antioquia Department. Its flagship Tahami Project (24,724 Ha) is adjacent to Aris Mining's Segovia Operations, one of the world's highest-grade underground gold mines. In 2025 Quimbaya completed a 12-hole / 5,320 m inaugural diamond drill program at Tahami South, confirming two Segovia-style epithermal vein systems. A Cu-Au-Mo porphyry system at Tahami Center was independently confirmed by Dr. Stewart Redwood in November 2025. The company is listed on the CSE (QIM), OTCQX (QIMGF), and Frankfurt Stock Exchange (K05). Incorporated May 27, 2020.

name: Quebec Innovative Materials Corp.
description: Québec Innovative Materials Corp. (CSE: QIMC; OTCQB: QIMCF; FSE: 7FJ), formerly Québec Silica Resources Corp., is a mineral exploration and development company with a portfolio of natural resource assets including high-grade silica, natural (white) hydrogen, and helium properties across Quebec, Ontario, Nova Scotia, and Minnesota (USA). The company is headquartered in Montreal and is focused on advancing its flagship natural hydrogen project at St-Bruno-de-Guigues (Ville Marie, QC), its discovery-stage Cumberland Basin hydrogen project in Nova Scotia, and high-grade silica projects at Charlevoix (QC) and River Valley (ON). QIMC partners with Institut National de la Recherche Scientifique (INRS) as its technical advisor.

name: Questcorp Mining Inc.
description: Questcorp Mining Inc. is a junior mineral exploration company listed on the CSE. As of early 2026, the company holds two mineral assets: the North Island Copper Property (optioned, British Columbia, Canada) and the La Union / Union Project (optioned from Riverside Resources, Sonora, Mexico).

name: Quebec Rare Earth Elements Corp.
description: Quebec Rare Earth Elements Corp. (formerly Metallica Metals Corp., renamed Nov 2023) is a junior explorer focused on rare earth element (REE) projects in Quebec, Canada. The company holds four active Quebec REE properties (Carcajou, Lynx, Caribou, Moose) targeting TREO mineralisation in carbonatite/alkaline and IOCG settings, plus several legacy gold-silver and PGM properties in Ontario acquired during the Metallica Metals era.

name: Rain City Resources Inc.
description: Rain City Resources Inc. is a Calgary-based Direct Lithium Extraction (DLE) technology company focused on commercializing its proprietary ACCELi (Advanced Chemical Cavitation Extraction of Lithium) process. The technology, originally developed by Avonlea Environmental Technologies Corp., uses hydrodynamic cavitation to extract lithium and other metals from brines. Rain City holds a 50% interest in the San Martín Joint Venture over ~150,000 ha of Argentine lithium brine concessions (Catamarca Province) via JV partner LAISA, and has signed MoUs/MoAs with Y-TEC (Argentina) and Pontifical Catholic University of Chile. The company's option to acquire Avonlea outright was terminated in October 2025; licensing negotiations are ongoing. As of March 2026, Rain City is subject to a Management Cease Trade Order (MCTO) issued by the Alberta Securities Commission for late filing of FY2025 annual financials. The company has zero revenue and going concern risk noted in financial statements.

name: Resource Centrix Holdings Inc.
description: Resource Centrix Holdings Inc. (formerly AI Centrix Resource Holdings Inc., formerly AI Centrix Technologies Corp.) is a junior mineral exploration company incorporated in British Columbia, Canada, and listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE: RECE) since October 18, 2023. The company holds an exclusive option to acquire a 100% interest in the Sylvest Property, a copper-gold porphyry exploration project located in the Omineca Mining Division, British Columbia, approximately 21 km northwest of the producing Mount Milligan Cu-Au mine. As of March 2026, the company has completed Phase 1 non-drilling geophysical and geochemical surveys and is advancing toward a first drill program. No NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate has been established.

name: Red Canyon Resources Ltd.
description: Red Canyon Resources Ltd. is a junior exploration company focused on copper-gold porphyry discovery across a portfolio of 100%-owned properties in British Columbia, Canada, and the western United States. The company's flagship Kendal Cu-Mo project (BC) confirmed a porphyry discovery in 2024 with two diamond drill programs completed. Teck Resources acquired a 9.9% equity stake in September 2025.

name: Reflex Advanced Materials Corp.
description: Reflex Advanced Materials Corp. (CSE: RFLX | OTC: RFLXF | FSE: HF2) is a Vancouver-based junior exploration company incorporated in British Columbia in 2021. The company was formerly known as Reflex Exploration Inc. (original name), then Freedom Battery Metals Inc. (renamed April 2022), and adopted its current name in October 2022. As of early 2026, the company holds no active mineral properties following the termination of its Ruby Graphite option (September 2025) and the sale of its ZigZag Lithium property (January 2024). The company is undergoing corporate restructuring including a 10:1 share consolidation (effective October 9, 2025) and a series of debt settlement transactions.

name: Renforth Resources Inc.
description: Renforth Resources Inc. is a Quebec- and Ontario-focused junior explorer with two flagship assets: the Parbec Gold Deposit (development-stage, Malartic, QC; 2025 MRE 265,800 M+I oz + 97,000 Inferred oz Au) and the Victoria Polymetallic Deposit within the Malartic Metals Package (MMP; initial 2025 MRE 125 Mt @ 0.15% NiEq = 413 Mlb NiEq). The 300 km² MMP also hosts the Beaupré Cu-Ag discovery and the Lalonde polymetallic occurrence. The Nixon-Bartleman gold property in the Porcupine camp rounds out the portfolio. Parbec is immediately adjacent to the Canadian Malartic Mine (Agnico Eagle) and bulk-sample permitting is underway.

name: Red Lake Gold Inc.
description: Red Lake Gold Inc. is a junior gold exploration company listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange. Its principal asset is the Whirlwind Jack Gold Project in the Red Lake District of Ontario, immediately adjacent to the Kinross Great Bear (LP Fault / Dixie) corridor. The company also holds early-stage gold projects in Québec and Saskatchewan and copper ground near Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario. Former assets include the Celt Lake Lithium and Preston District Uranium projects (both lapsed/reverted) and the Alma Gold spin-out properties in New Brunswick.

name: Rush Gold Corp.
description: Rush Gold Corp. is a British Columbia-incorporated junior explorer focused on district-scale epithermal gold-silver exploration in the Republic Mining District, Nye County, Nevada (Walker Lane structural corridor). The company holds options on two properties — Skylight and Legal Tender — both optioned from Silver Range Resources Ltd. Rush Gold completed its CSE IPO in June 2025, raising CAD $450,000. As of March 2026, the company is conducting surface sampling, satellite alteration mapping (WorldView-3), and initiating drill permitting at both properties. No NI 43-101 mineral resource or reserve has been defined on either property.

name: Rio Grande Resources Ltd.
description: Rio Grande Resources Ltd. (CSE: RGR | OTCQB: RGRLF) is a Vancouver-based gold and silver exploration company focused on the Winston Group of Properties in the Chloride Mining Sub-District, Black Range Mountains, Sierra County, New Mexico, USA. The company was spun out of Foremost Clean Energy Ltd. via a Plan of Arrangement completed January 31, 2025, and commenced CSE trading on February 7, 2025. The company holds 149 unpatented and patented BLM lode claims (3,037 acres / 1,229 ha) covering three historic high-grade gold-silver mines — Ivanhoe, Emporia, and Little Granite — plus broader unpatented claims along the 25 km Paymaster Fault structural corridor. CEO/President: Jason Barnard. QP: Dahrouge Geological Consulting USA Ltd. (engaged Q4 2025); formerly Dr. Michael Feinstein, PhD, CPG (2021–2025). No NI 43-101 or SK-1300 technical report has been filed as of March 2026.

name: Rise Gold Corp.
description: Rise Gold Corp. is a junior gold exploration company focused on the Idaho-Maryland Gold Mine near Grass Valley, Nevada County, California — a historic past-producer that produced approximately 2.4 million ounces of gold at an average head grade of 17.1 g/t Au between 1866 and 1955. The project is held 100% through wholly-owned subsidiary Rise Grass Valley Inc. Rise has no current NI 43-101 or JORC mineral resource estimate; historical estimates exist but are not treated as current resources. In 2025, the company commenced a review of tungsten exploration potential at the project.

name: Rockland Resources Ltd.
description: Rockland Resources Ltd. is a junior Canadian mineral exploration company focused on gold in the Red Lake Mining District of Ontario, while also holding a portfolio of critical mineral assets (beryllium, tungsten, lithium) in Utah and other jurisdictions. The flagship Cole Gold Mines property is an active 2026 drill target located adjacent to the West Red Lake Gold and Evolution Mining complexes.

name: Red Metal Resources Ltd.
description: Red Metal Resources Ltd. is a junior exploration company focused on copper-gold-cobalt exploration in the Atacama Region of Chile (Carrizal IOCG belt) and early-stage natural hydrogen exploration in the Timiskaming Graben of Quebec and Ontario, Canada. The flagship Carrizal Property (Farellon + Perth) is situated along the Candelaria IOCG belt, adjacent to the historic Carrizal Alto mine complex. No NI 43-101 resource estimate has been published as of March 2026.

name: Mineral Road Discovery Inc.
description: Mineral Road Discovery Inc. (formerly Crest Resources Inc., renamed September 2024) is a Vancouver-based junior exploration company listed on the CSE. The company holds a multi-asset, multi-jurisdiction portfolio including vanadium (Australia), magnesite/magnesium (Australia), polymetallic silver-lead-zinc-gold (British Columbia, Canada), copper-gold-nickel-cobalt-PGE (Quebec, Canada), uranium (Quebec, Canada), and tungsten (Sweden). The company also holds an ~42% equity stake in Golcap Resources Corp. (CSE: GCP). Key executives include Damien Reynolds (Executive Chairman/CEO). Formerly traded as Crest Resources Inc. (CSE: CRES).

name: Rocky Shore Gold Ltd.
description: Rocky Shore Gold Ltd. (formerly Hemlo Explorers) is a junior exploration company focused on district-scale gold discovery in central Newfoundland. Its flagship Gold Anchor Project covers over 1,225 sq km on trend with New Found Gold's Queensway Project. The company sold its Ontario claims portfolio (Pic, Project Idaho, North Limb) to Barrick in July 2025 and retains a variable-rate royalty of up to 0.50% NSR on those claims.

name: Rush Rare Metals Corp.
description: Rush Rare Metals Corp. (formerly Rush Uranium Corp., name changed March 2023) is a Canadian junior explorer incorporated October 2021, listed on the CSE. The company holds two assets: the 100%-owned Boxi REE-Nb-U Property in Québec, Canada (pegmatite-hosted niobium, REE, and uranium mineralization; surface exploration stage), and a 25% joint venture interest in the Copper Mountain Uranium Project in Wyoming, USA (Myriad Uranium Corp. holds 75% as operator after completing a $5.5M+ earn-in in December 2025). A definitive merger agreement with Myriad Uranium Corp. was announced February 13, 2026, pending regulatory and shareholder approval.

name: Refined Energy Corp.
description: Refined Energy Corp. (formerly Refined Metals Corp.) is a uranium exploration company focused on the Athabasca Basin, Saskatchewan. The company holds option interests in three Saskatchewan uranium properties (Dufferin, Basin, and Milner Lake) and commenced its maiden drill program at Dufferin West in March 2026. The company completed a change of business from cannabis (as Chemesis International Inc.) in November 2022, pivoted through lithium in 2022–2023, and rebranded to its current uranium focus in March 2024.

name: Rift Valley Resources Corp.
description: Rift Valley Resources Corp. is a CSE-listed junior exploration company (currently suspended / subject to reciprocal CTO as of 2025-2026). Its sole identified mineral property was the Cat Mountain alkalic porphyry Cu-Au prospect in north-central British Columbia, held under an option/earn-in arrangement from 2011. The company disclosed a default notice on the option in 2015, impaired the mineral property at year-end 2015, and subsequently pivoted its principal business to wireless and other opportunities. No NI 43-101 compliant resource has been established on Cat Mountain.

name: Rockex Mining Corporation
description: Rockex Mining Corporation is a junior mining company headquartered in Thunder Bay, Ontario, focused primarily on iron ore exploration and development in Northwestern Ontario. Its flagship asset is the Western Lake St. Joseph Iron Project (Eagle Island Deposit), which hosts a NI 43-101 compliant resource of 1,287 Mt indicated and 108 Mt inferred iron ore. The company also holds interests in several other iron formation and lithium pegmatite properties in the Patricia and Red Lake Mining Divisions. Rockex listed on the TSX in March 2011 and subsequently transferred to the CSE.

name: Sanu Gold Corp
description: Sanu Gold Corp is a CSE-listed junior gold exploration company focused on the Siguiri Basin of Guinea, West Africa. The company holds three exploration permits — Daina, Diguifara, and Bantabaye — in one of Africa's premier gold districts. Since 2022, Sanu has conducted extensive auger, RC, air-core, and diamond drilling campaigns across all three permits, delineating multiple kilometre-scale mineralized corridors.

name: Sasquatch Resources Corp.
description: Sasquatch Resources Corp. is a junior mineral exploration company focused on waste-rock reclamation and near-surface VMS and orogenic gold exploration across Vancouver Island and southwestern British Columbia. The company targets legacy mine sites with surface-accessible Cu-Au-Ag-Zn material, applying modern ore-sorting and small-scale processing techniques to historic mining districts. Key properties include the flagship Mount Sicker VMS project (southern Vancouver Island), Blue Grouse, Santana, Slesse Gold Claims, and the Port Alberni Claim Group.

name: Sassy Gold Corp
description:
Sassy Gold Corp is a junior exploration company focused on precious metals in Canada.
    Its flagship asset is the 100%-owned Foremore Project (14,585 ha) in the Eskay Camp of
    northwestern British Columbia, where the Westmore Discovery Zone has returned high-grade
    gold-silver intercepts from 36 diamond drill holes (7,908 m, 2020–2022). The company
    also holds an option to earn 100% of the Ashuanipi Gold Property (22,000 ha, Labrador),
    a 20% interest in the Highrock Uranium Project (Saskatchewan, operator: Forum Energy
    Metals), and equity positions in Gander Gold Corp (CSE: GAND, ~40%), Galloper Gold Corp
    (CSE: BOOM), and MAX Power Mining Corp (CSE: MAXX). As of November 2025 Sassy is subject
    to an FFCTO for failure to file annual financials and has no confirmed active drill programs.

name: Steadright Critical Minerals Inc.
description: Steadright Critical Minerals Inc. is a junior exploration company focused on critical minerals and polymetallic projects across Canada and Morocco. Its portfolio includes the RAM district Ni-Cu-Co-PGE project in Québec, silica claims in Ontario, and a growing suite of Moroccan assets including the TitanBeach titanium heavy-mineral-sand project, the historic Goundafa polymetallic mine, and several copper-lead-silver and lead-fluorite-barite exploration permits. The company completed a 2-for-1 share consolidation effective November 6, 2024.

name: Sankamap Metals Inc.
description: Sankamap Metals Inc. (formerly Maclaren Minerals Ltd.) is a junior exploration company focused on porphyry and epithermal gold-copper targets in the Solomon Islands, held through its 100%-owned subsidiary Sankamap Exploration Inc. The company also holds a 75% earned interest in the Boer copper-silver-gold property in British Columbia, Canada. The company changed its name and ticker to SCU in March 2025 following the acquisition of Sankamap Exploration Inc.

name: Scotch Creek Ventures Inc.
description: Scotch Creek Ventures is a Vancouver-based exploration company focused on the acquisition and exploration of lithium properties in Nevada, USA. The company holds 100% interest in three active lithium properties in Esmeralda County — Highlands West, Macallan East, and Miranda — all targeting lithium brine and/or claystone mineralization within the Esmeralda Formation, adjacent to the only producing lithium mine in North America (Albemarle Silver Peak). The company was incorporated in January 2017 and listed on the CSE in December 2018.

name: Seahawk Ventures Inc.
description: Seahawk Ventures Inc. (formerly Seahawk Gold Corp.) is a junior gold exploration company focused on the Urban-Barry Greenstone Belt, Abitibi sub-province, Quebec. The company holds four active Quebec gold properties (Touchdown, Blitz, Mystery, Xtra Point) totalling approximately 12,660 ha, and has a pending acquisition of four US properties in Arizona and New Mexico (subject to CSE and shareholder approval). Seahawk also retains a 2% NSR royalty on the formerly-held SkyX property. The company is the second-largest landholder in the Urban-Barry Gold Camp, contiguous to Osisko Mining's Windfall Property (18.6 Mt @ 8.5 g/t Au) and BonTerra's Gladiator Property (3.5 Mt @ 6.27 g/t Au).

name: Deep Sea Minerals Corp.
description: Deep Sea Minerals Corp. (formerly Copperhead Resources Inc., CSE: CUH; name change effective January 26, 2026) is a Canadian exploration-stage company pursuing deep-sea polymetallic nodule concessions in the Cook Islands EEZ and U.S. federal offshore waters under the NOAA DSHMRA framework. The company also holds (pending disposal) an option on the Twilite Gold Project in Central Newfoundland. Its strategic focus is on critical minerals (nickel, cobalt, copper, manganese) from seabed polymetallic nodule deposits.

name: Serra Energy Metals Corp.
description: Serra Energy Metals Corp. (formerly E79 Resources Corp.) is a Vancouver-based junior explorer incorporated in 2018. The company holds two advanced gold exploration properties in Victoria, Australia (Myrtleford and Beaufort) under E79 Resources Pty Ltd, and a greenfield lithium pegmatite project in Bahia, Brazil (Santa Luz). As of March 2026, an 80% interest in the Australian properties is subject to a sale agreement with Advance Metals (ASX: AVM) signed December 2024, and the company is undergoing an RTO amalgamation with ROV Investment Partners (UBERDOC Health Technologies). All mineral assets are being divested as part of the corporate pivot.

name: Sierra Grande Minerals Inc.
description: Junior mineral exploration company incorporated in 1994 (formerly Sierra Growth Corp., renamed July 2021). Headquartered in Surrey, BC, Canada. Engaged in the acquisition, exploration, and development of early-stage mineral prospects focused on gold, silver, copper and molybdenum in Nevada, USA. Also holds a legacy Silveria property in Peru (optioned to CIEMSA). Listed on CSE (SGRO), OTC (SIERF), and FSE (F9IQ). QP: Charles J. 'Charlie' Greig, MSc., P.Geo.

name: Showcase Minerals Inc.
description: Showcase Minerals Inc. is a junior mineral exploration company listed on the CSE (SHOW) and FSE (ZJ0), with a portfolio of gold, silver, uranium, and vanadium exploration properties in Nevada (USA), Quebec, and British Columbia (Canada). All properties are at the exploration stage with no NI 43-101 mineral resource estimates defined as at March 2026.

name: Silicon Metals Corp.
description: Silicon Metals Corp. (formerly West Oak Gold Corp.) is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on high-purity silica (HPQ) properties in British Columbia and Ontario. The company holds five active silica projects targeting quartzite and pegmatite formations as feedstock for semiconductor, solar, and silicon metal markets. The company changed its name and pivot strategy in October 2024. As of March 2026, the company is in the exploration and early-development stage with no NI 43-101 mineral resource estimates filed.

name: Rottenstone Gold Inc.
description: Rottenstone Gold Inc. (formerly 79 Resources Ltd.) is a junior mining exploration company focused on gold and copper in Canada. The company holds the Rottenstone Project (282,951 ha, Saskatchewan) and Five Point Copper-Gold Project (56,394 ha, British Columbia), both at the early grassroots exploration stage with no drilling conducted to date. As of March 2026, trading is halted pending CSE review of a proposed repositioning into a royalty company (Silver Royalties Corp.) through the acquisition of six royalties on operating projects including Great Bear (Kinross), Seabee (SSR Mining), Goldboro (NexGold), Bloom Lake East (Champion Iron), Preston Uranium (Orano), and a Cameco-operated western Athabasca Basin project. Incorporated April 17, 2019 in British Columbia. Formerly listed as SNR (79 Resources Ltd.); name and ticker changed December 17/23, 2024.

name: Super Lithium Corp.
description: Super Lithium Corp. is an early-stage mineral exploration company incorporated in British Columbia, Canada (December 17, 2021), listed on the CSE on September 3, 2025. The Company holds a single asset — an exclusive option to acquire 100% of the Railroad Valley Lithium Project in Nye County, Nevada, USA. The property targets lithium-enriched brines hosted in sub-surface aquifers within a playa basin analogous to the Clayton Valley (Silver Peak) brine deposit in Nevada.

name: Silver Acadia Exploration Inc.
description: Silver Acadia Exploration Inc. (formerly Canadian Metals Inc., ticker CME) is a junior mineral exploration company focused on silver-polymetallic and gold exploration in the Bathurst Mining Camp of New Brunswick, Canada. The company changed its name and ticker effective February 11, 2026. It holds five properties totalling approximately 25,155 ha (250 km²) along the Rocky Brook-Millstream Deformation Zone (RBMDZ).

name: Starlo Ventures Ltd.
description: Exploration-stage mining company focused on precious metals (gold, silver). Incorporated November 26, 2021 in British Columbia, Canada. Listed on the CSE March 27, 2023. Holds one exploration asset: the Mt. Richards Property on southern Vancouver Island, BC. No revenue and no commercial production. CEO and founder Patrick De Witt; CFO Steven Krause (appointed September 30, 2025). Property held via an unnamed wholly-owned subsidiary.

name: Silver Dollar Resources Inc.
description: Silver Dollar Resources Inc. is a junior mineral exploration company focused on silver-dominant precious and base metal projects in Mexico and Canada. Its flagship asset is the La Joya Silver (Cu-Au) Project in Durango State, Mexico, a polymetallic skarn/CRD/epithermal-related system previously explored by SilverCrest Mines and First Majestic Silver. The company also holds the early-stage Nora Silver-Gold Project in Durango State and retains two legacy properties in the Red Lake area of Ontario.

name: Slave Lake Zinc Corp.
description: Slave Lake Zinc Corp. is an early-stage mineral exploration company focused on the O'Connor Lake Pb-Zn-Ag-Cu property in the South Slave Region of the Northwest Territories, Canada. The property covers 7,813.18 ha including the historic MWK lease (originally 188.18 ha), expanded through a 2020 Collaboration Agreement with the NWT Métis Nation. The project hosts multiple high-grade vein systems with a recently identified 8×5 km deep-seated hydrothermal metal zonation corridor. No NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate has been established. The company holds a Type B Water License and Land Use Permit. No drilling has been conducted by SLZ as of March 2026.

name: Spod Lithium Corp.
description: Spod Lithium Corp. is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on lithium and gold assets. The company held multiple LCT spodumene pegmatite properties in Ontario and Quebec's James Bay region (Corvette Lithium Trend), as well as a gold-copper property near Chibougamau, Quebec. As of early 2026, the company divested its Ontario lithium assets and Quebec lithium option properties, retaining 100% ownership of the Golden Moon gold-copper property near Chibougamau, Quebec.

name: Spark Energy Minerals Inc.
description: Spark Energy Minerals Inc. (formerly St. Anthony Gold Corp., name changed effective January 3, 2023) is a Vancouver-based junior explorer focused on the acquisition, exploration and development of battery metals — lithium, rare earth elements (REE), and gallium — in Brazil. The company's flagship is the 91,900 ha Arapaima Lithium and REE Project in Minas Gerais, located within the Eastern Brazilian Pegmatite Province approximately 11–15 km east of Sigma Lithium's producing Grota do Cirilo mine. The company also holds two secondary lithium properties in Ceará and Rio Grande do Norte states. Listed CSE: SPRK | OTC Pink: SPARF | Frankfurt: 8PC. ~153 million shares outstanding (Feb 2026); market cap ~C$8.46M.

name: Sranan Gold Corp.
description: Sranan Gold Corp. (formerly Peak Minerals Ltd., name change effective April 7–8, 2025) is a gold exploration company incorporated in 2021 in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. The company controls approximately 47,500 hectares across three properties: the flagship Tapanahony Gold Project (29,000 ha, Suriname), the Lawantino Gold Project (18,468 ha, Suriname, under option), and the Aida Property (2,335 ha, British Columbia, Canada). Tapanahony hosts the Randy–Poeketi 4.5 km orogenic gold shear trend; active diamond drilling since mid-2025 has confirmed a high-grade orogenic gold system. Also trades as OTCQB: SRANF and FSE/Tradegate: P84.

name: Sorrento Resources Ltd.
description: Sorrento Resources Ltd. is a Canadian junior explorer focused on critical minerals and precious metals in Newfoundland. Flagship projects include the Bottom Brook REE (peralkaline leucogranite-hosted) and Rodgers Cove Gold (orogenic, Appleton Fault Zone) properties, both in active drill programs as of early 2026. The company trades on the CSE (SRS) and OTCQB (SRSLF).

name: Starmet Ventures Inc.
description: Starmet Ventures Inc. (formerly SaveCann Solutions Inc.) is a junior mineral exploration company focused on the acquisition, exploration, and development of natural resource properties in Canada and the USA. The company holds a gold exploration property in Nevada (JPL Gold Property) and a lithium exploration property in Ontario (Ear Falls Lithium Property), in addition to a 30% profit-rights interest in a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) project in Germany acquired in May 2025.

name: Star Copper Corp.
description: Star Copper Corp. is a junior mineral exploration company focused on copper-gold porphyry discovery in British Columbia, Canada. Its flagship Star Project is located in the Golden Triangle/Sheslay district of northwestern BC. The company also holds the Indata Project (option/earn-in), Copperline Property, and Quesnel Project. The Okeover Project was spun out to Alpha Copper Corp. in May 2025.

name: StrategX Elements Corp.
description: StrategX Elements Corp. is a Canadian junior exploration company focused on critical and strategic minerals. The company holds a portfolio of properties in Nunavut (Melville Peninsula) and the Northwest Territories (East Arm of Great Slave Lake), targeting nickel, copper, cobalt, vanadium, graphite, and associated polymetallic mineralisation. Its flagship Nagvaak project on Melville Peninsula, Nunavut, has delineated a 6,000 m × 500 m polymetallic corridor. No NI 43-101 resource estimate has been defined on any property as of early 2026.

name: Silverstock Metals Inc.
description: Silverstock Metals Inc. is a British Columbia-incorporated junior exploration company listed on the CSE. The company holds an option to acquire 100% interest in the Gold Cutter Property, a polymetallic exploration-stage project located in the Kamloops Mining Division of British Columbia. The property is situated along the Early Jurassic Wildhorse-Takomkane plutonic suite within the Quesnellia terrane — the same regional belt hosting Highland Valley, Mount Polley, and Gibraltar porphyry mines. Surface exploration completed in 2020–2021 identified auriferous polymetallic quartz veins associated with intrusive dikes; no drilling has been conducted to date.

name: UraniumX Discovery Corp.
description: UraniumX Discovery Corp. (formerly Stearman Resources Inc., name changed effective December 31, 2025) is a uranium exploration company focused on the Athabasca Basin, Saskatchewan, Canada. The company holds a three-property portfolio: Murphy Lake (earning 70% via option from F4 Uranium Corp.), Zoo Bay (100% owned, 19,850 ha), and NeoCore (100% owned, 13,012 ha). All properties target unconformity-hosted and basement-hosted uranium mineralization in one of the world's premier uranium jurisdictions. Also listed on OTC Pink: STMFX and FSE: A41L7T. Incorporated 2022; head office: Suite 170 – 422 Richards St., Vancouver, BC V6B 2Z4. CEO: Esen Boldkhuu; COO/President: Kirby Renton; Director of Exploration/QP: Ken Wheatley, P.Geo., M.Sc. Strategic Advisor: Vincent Martin (former Orano Canada CEO). Closed $4.31M LIFE financing February 13, 2026 at $0.20/unit.

name: Stinger Resources Inc.
description: Stinger Resources Inc. is a junior mineral exploration company incorporated in 2020 and spun out from American Creek Resources Ltd. on February 17, 2021. The company is headquartered in Cardston, Alberta and holds a portfolio of British Columbia exploration properties, with the flagship 100%-owned Dunwell Mine property (~2,493 ha) located in the Golden Triangle near Stewart, BC. The company trades on the CSE under STNG and on the OTCQB under STNRF. QP/Geologist: Jim McCrea, P.Geo. Stinger has no NI 43-101 compliant mineral resource estimates on any of its properties; all assets are exploration-stage.

name: Surface Metals Inc.
description: Surface Metals Inc. (formerly ACME Lithium Inc., name changed April 25, 2025) is a North American mineral exploration company focused on advancing a diversified portfolio of gold and lithium projects in Nevada, USA. Also cross-listed on OTCQB (SURMF) and Frankfurt Stock Exchange (FSE: V6X). Incorporated 2017, headquartered in Vancouver, BC, Canada. CEO: Steve Hanson. Address: 318-1199 West Pender St, Vancouver, V6E 2R1.

name: Strathmore Plus Uranium Corp.
description: Strathmore Plus Uranium Corp. (CSE: SUU / OTCQB: SUUFF) is an exploration-stage company focused on the acquisition, exploration, and development of in-situ recoverable (ISR) uranium deposits in the State of Wyoming, USA. The company holds three uranium projects — Agate, Beaver Rim, and Night Owl — all located in historically productive Wyoming uranium districts. Incorporated in 2007 and headquartered in Kelowna, British Columbia, Canada. Listed on the CSE in May 2025.

name: St-Georges Eco-Mining Corp.
description: St-Georges Eco-Mining Corp. is a CSE-listed junior exploration and critical-minerals company with active Ni-Cu-Co-PGE and Nb-REE mineral properties in Québec, gold exploration assets in Iceland (held through subsidiary Iceland Resources EHF / St-Georges Iceland Ltd.), and a battery-materials processing subsidiary (EVSX Corp.) operating in Thorold, Ontario. The company's flagship is the Manicouagan Ni-Cu-Co-PGE project in northern Québec, complemented by the Julie Ni-Cu-PGE project and the Notre-Dame Nb-Ta-Ga-REE critical-minerals project.

name: Talmora Diamond Inc.
description: Talmora Diamond Inc. is a junior diamond exploration company focused entirely on its Horton River Project in the Northwest Territories, Canada. The company holds prospecting permits and mineral claims totalling approximately 160,000+ ha in the Lena West diamond region, on the Mackenzie Craton, approximately 120 km south of Paulatuk. The project hosts 40+ kimberlite pipe targets identified through systematic airborne magnetics and till sampling since 2004. The Seahorse Sub-Project, a 50/50 JV with Olivut Resources Ltd., hosts a large magnetic anomaly comparable in size to the world's largest known kimberlites, beneath Seahorse Lake, and has returned one confirmed macrodiamond and 19 microdiamonds from beach sand sampling programs.

name: Tana Resources Corp.
description: Junior mineral exploration company focused on the acquisition and development of mineral properties in Canada. Incorporated in 2020 and headquartered in Vancouver, BC. As of March 2026, Tana holds NO active property interests following the lapse of the King–Double T option (June 2025) and termination of the Mount Polley West option by Eagle Plains Resources (~February/March 2026).

name: Taurus Gold Corp.
description: Taurus Gold Corp. (formerly Nouagoha Mining Inc., renamed August 2020) is a junior gold exploration company incorporated in 2019 and headquartered in Calgary/Edmonton, Alberta. The company holds its sole asset, the Charlotte Property, an epithermal gold-silver exploration project in the Dawson Range, Yukon Territory, Canada.

name: Terra Clean Energy Corp.
description: Terra Clean Energy Corp. (formerly Tisdale Clean Energy Corp., renamed October 2024) is a uranium exploration and development company incorporated in 1972, headquartered in Vancouver, BC. The company holds a portfolio of uranium projects in Northern Saskatchewan (Canada), Utah (USA), and Wyoming (USA), targeting near-term resource growth and district-scale uranium opportunities. Also traded on OTCQB: TCEFF and FSE: C9O0.

name: Terra Balcanica Resources Corp.
description: Terra Balcanica Resources Corp. is a CSE-listed junior explorer focused on epithermal Ag-Sb-Pb-Zn and Au-skarn/porphyry targets in the Srebrenica Mining District of Bosnia and Herzegovina (flagship Viogor-Zanik Project, 90% interest), polymetallic licences in Serbia's Raska/Kopaonik metallogenic zone, and a Saskatchewan uranium portfolio being spun out into Terra North Resources Corp. The company has completed three phases of diamond drilling at Viogor-Zanik and is advancing towards a preliminary mineral resource estimate.

name: Targa Exploration Corp.
description: Canadian gold and lithium exploration company engaged in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties. Headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. Formerly known as RCM Minerals Ltd.; renamed Targa Exploration Corp. in July 2021. Flagship asset is the Opinaca Gold Project in James Bay, Quebec, where 2025 maiden drilling discovered a 4 km-long gold system. Also holds options on two epithermal Au-Ag projects in Santa Cruz, Argentina (El Zanjon and Venidero).

name: Trojan Gold Inc.
description: Trojan Gold Inc. is a junior gold exploration company listed on the CSE. The company holds interests in three properties in Ontario, Canada: the Hemlo South property (50% JV with Tashota Resources, adjacent to Barrick's Williams Mine), the Watershed property (100% owned, Shebandowan Greenstone Belt), and the Paulpic-Wascanna property (50% option interest, Beardmore-Geraldton Belt with NI 43-101 inferred resource of 68,900 oz Au). As of March 2026, the company has entered into a non-binding LOI for a proposed business combination with Tashota Resources Inc. and Strike Copper.

name: Torrent Gold Inc.
description: Torrent Gold Inc. (formerly Raindrop Ventures Inc., renamed April 2022) is a British Columbia-incorporated junior mineral exploration company focused on gold and silver properties in the western United States. The company holds four active exploration-stage properties in Idaho and Nevada acquired from Liberty Gold Corp. in March 2021, plus its original Clover Mountain property in Idaho acquired in September 2018. No resource estimates have been filed under NI 43-101. As of March 2026 the company completed a CAD$480,000 private placement and holds a portfolio of early-stage projects in the Great Basin epithermal and Carlin-type gold belts.

name: Talent Infinity Resource Developments Inc.
description: Vancouver-based junior explorer (CSE: TICO) focused on critical metals and precious metals exploration in British Columbia and New Brunswick, Canada. Incorporated 2020; listed on CSE after January 14, 2022 (formerly Talent Infinity Capital Fund Corporation). CEO: John Eren (effective Feb 4, 2026). VP Exploration: Graham Giles, P.Geo. (effective March 10, 2026). Market cap ~CAD 3.48M (early 2026). Company is pre-drill across its entire portfolio as of March 2026.

name: Temas Resources Corp.
description: Temas Resources Corp. is a Canadian junior mining company focused on titanium, vanadium, and iron oxide (Fe-Ti-V) projects in Quebec, Canada. Its flagship La Blache Fe-Ti-V Project (208.5 Mt inferred, 16.7% TiO2 Eq) hosts a NI 43-101 PEA (C$6.6B NPV8 post-tax, 60.8% IRR). The company also owns 100% of ORF Technologies Inc., developer of the patented Regenerative Chloride Leach (RCL) hydrometallurgical platform with 11 granted process patents, which has produced 99.8% pure TiO2 from La Blache material. Temas is dual-listed on the CSE and ASX (TIO) and is advancing toward a JORC-compliant MRE in 2026.

name: Teako Minerals Corp.
description: Teako Minerals Corp. (formerly 1111 Exploration Corp., renamed Mar 2023) is a junior exploration company focused primarily on VMS copper-cobalt-zinc projects in Norway, with a large Norwegian Project Hub (53+ projects covering ~7,282 km²). Core assets include the Løkken, Venna, and Vaddas projects. The company also holds paused BC gold-copper projects (Yellow Moose, BQ, Teako Property) and retains 10% economic interests in 9 projects divested to Nordic Minerals AS (Jan 2026) and Fritzøe Skoger AS (Jul 2025).

name: Tartisan Nickel Corp.
