description: Tartisan Nickel Corp. is a Canadian junior mineral exploration company focused on its flagship Kenbridge Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project in northwestern Ontario. The company also holds the Turtle Pond / Night Danger Nickel-Copper Project and the Sill Lake Silver-Lead-Zinc Project, both in Ontario, through its wholly owned subsidiary Canadian Arrow Mines Limited. Tartisan previously held properties in Peru (Don Pancho, Ichuna) which have been divested or written off, and retains residual royalty interests in the Alexo-Kelex and La Victoria projects sold in prior years.

name: Tocvan Ventures Corp.
description: Tocvan Ventures Corp. is a junior exploration company focused on gold and silver projects in Sonora, Mexico. Its flagship asset is the Gran Pilar Gold-Silver Project, a district-scale epithermal system near Suaqui Grande. The company also holds the El Picacho Gold-Silver Project in the Caborca Orogenic Gold Belt.

name: Triple One Metals Inc.
description: Triple One Metals Inc. (formerly MLK Gold Ltd., renamed April 2023) is a junior exploration company focused on gold and critical/strategic metals (lithium, nickel) in Newfoundland & Labrador (primary) and Quebec (secondary). Headquartered in Shawnigan Lake, B.C. CEO: A. Paul Gill. The flagship Caledonia Brook gold project is situated on the Valentine Lake Structural Trend in central Newfoundland, the same geological setting as Equinox Gold's Valentine Lake deposit.

name: Tarachi Gold Corp.
description: Tarachi Gold Corp. (formerly Kal Minerals Corp.; renamed April 2020) is a Vancouver-based junior mining company incorporated in British Columbia in 2016. Also traded on OTCQB (TRGGF) and Frankfurt (4RZ). The company previously held gold exploration properties in Sonora, Mexico (Tarachi Project, terminated June 2023) and a gold tailings reprocessing mill in Durango, Mexico (Magistral Project, sold May 2023). As of March 2026, Tarachi holds no active mineral properties and is a cash-heavy shell (reported >C$3M) actively seeking a precious metals acquisition. CEO: Cameron Tymstra; VP Exploration: Lorne Warner, P.Geo.

name: Tantalex Lithium Resources Corporation
description: Tantalex Lithium Resources Corporation is a Canadian junior mining company focused on lithium, tin and tantalum in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Quebec, Canada. Its flagship Manono Lithium Tailings Project hosts a NI 43-101 resource (5.46 Mt M+I @ 0.72% Li2O; 6.63 Mt Inferred @ 0.49% Li2O) with a completed PEA (NPV10% US$764M, IRR 87.4%). The company also operates the TiTan Tin & Tantalum alluvial plant on License 12447 (first export April 2024) and is advancing a 25 km hard-rock LCT pegmatite corridor on Licenses 12447 and 12448 in Tanganyika Province.

name: Ubique Minerals Limited
description: Ubique Minerals Limited is a junior mineral exploration company focused on base and precious metal projects. Its core asset is a controlling interest (~99.66%) in Resource 500 V Ltd (R500), an Irish company holding Exclusive Prospecting Licences (EPLs) covering >1,600 km² in Namibia's Otavi Mountain Land and Erongo regions, targeting Cu-Pb-Zn-Ag and uranium mineralization. The company previously explored the Daniel's Harbour Zinc Project (MVT, Newfoundland), which was abandoned in FY2024. A proposed gold tailings acquisition in South Africa (Stanhove/MJR Mining) was announced in 2024 but not yet closed as of March 2026.

name: United Critical Minerals Corp.
description: United Critical Minerals Corp. (formerly Trimera Metals Corp. / Bluecap Mining Corp.) is a British Columbia-incorporated junior exploration company focused on critical minerals. The company holds 100% interest in the Tahlo Lake Property, a grass-roots copper-gold porphyry exploration project located ~80 km NE of Smithers, BC in the Babine Copper-Gold Porphyry District. The company listed on the CSE under ticker TRM in June 2025 and changed its name and ticker to UCM effective December 1, 2025.

name: Urano Energy Corp.
description: Urano Energy Corp. (formerly C2C Metals Corp.) is a junior exploration company focused on uranium and vanadium properties on the Colorado Plateau (Utah and Colorado, USA) and gold properties in the Central Newfoundland Gold Belt and Yukon, Canada. The company rebranded from C2C Metals to Urano Energy in 2024 concurrent with building out a large uranium portfolio through staking and acquisitions.

name: Upside Gold Corp.
description: Upside Gold Corp. is a CSE-listed junior explorer focused on the Kena Gold-Copper Project in southeastern British Columbia, Canada. The company holds an option to acquire 100% of the property from West Mining Corp. through cash, share and exploration-spend commitments running to January 20, 2028.

name: United Lithium Corp.
description: United Lithium Corp. is a junior exploration company focused on lithium and critical mineral projects in Scandinavia and North America. Core assets include the Bergby and Axmarby lithium projects in Sweden, the Kietyönmäki lithium project in Finland, and the Liberty and Patriot lithium projects in the United States. In January 2026 the company expanded into uranium and REE through acquisition of Swedish Minerals AB.

name: US Critical Metals Corp.
description: US Critical Metals Corp. is a junior exploration company focused on critical and energy metals in the United States. Its portfolio includes lithium claystone projects in Nevada, a cobalt project in Idaho's Blackbird Mining District, a uranium-vanadium project in Idaho, and rare earth projects in Montana and Idaho held through an earn-in arrangement with US Rare Elements Corp.

name: Puranium Energy Ltd.
description: Puranium Energy Ltd. is a uranium exploration company focused on five Exclusive Prospecting Licences (EPLs) covering 81,955 ha in the Erongo Province of Namibia, adjacent to producing mines including Langer Heinrich, Husab, and Rössing. Puranium holds an 85% interest in all EPLs, with 15% retained by Namibian local partners. The company was formerly known as Monterey Minerals Inc. (name changed March/April 2022). Also holds non-core legacy assets in British Columbia and Ontario, Canada.

name: Pedro Resources Ltd.
description: Pedro Resources Ltd. (formerly BasicGov Systems Inc.) is a Canadian junior company listed on the CSE. Its primary mineral asset is the Voisey's Bay West (VBW) Ni-Cu-Co sulphide property in Northern Labrador, held 100% through subsidiary Voisey's Bay West Nickel & Cobalt Corp. (VBN Corp.). As of 2023–2026, the company is pursuing a proposed change of business to bioscience/biotechnology while retaining its mineral licences. The VBW property has not been drilled; no NI 43-101 resource estimate exists for Pedro's tenure. A former vanadium property (Graysill Mine, Colorado) was announced for acquisition in 2018 but does not appear in any post-2020 filings and is believed abandoned or never formally closed.

name: Vortex Energy Corp.
description: Vortex Energy Corp. (formerly Sustainable Green Mining Corp., renamed June 2022) is a junior exploration company focused on salt cavern energy storage and uranium. Its flagship Robinsons River Salt Project in Newfoundland targets halite extraction and underground hydrogen/CO₂ storage caverns. The company also holds an option on the Fire Eye Uranium Property in Saskatchewan's Wollaston Domain. Incorporated 2021; listed on the CSE as VRTX and OTC as VTECF.

name: Waraba Gold Limited
description: Waraba Gold Limited (formerly Zenith Exploration Inc., renamed Oct 23, 2020) is a junior gold exploration company incorporated in 2015 and listed on the CSE (Oct 11, 2018). The company holds a 75% economic interest in the Fokolore Gold Project (Maligonga East) in western Mali, and earn-in rights of up to 80% in two gold licences in northern Ivory Coast (Sirasso and Tengrela). All properties are early-stage exploration with no NI 43-101 resource estimates published to date.

name: Wedgemount Resources Corp.
description: Wedgemount Resources Corp. (CSE: WDGY, OTCQB: WDGRF) is a junior oil and gas producer focused on the acquisition, optimization, and exploitation of conventional producing assets in the Permian Basin of west-central Texas (Runnels, Taylor, and Coleman Counties). The company's strategy is to acquire low-entry-cost, underperforming conventional vertical wells and apply proprietary chemical enhanced-recovery treatments to organically grow production. As of March 2026, Wedgemount operates 136 producing wells and 10 injectors across four core asset areas (Willowbend, Millican, TCS, and Huggy), with a combined 24-hour test rate of 841 boed (80% oil/condensate, 20% gas). The company also holds legacy BC mineral exploration properties (Cookie Cu-Au, Eagle Cu-Au, Friendly Lake–Deer Lake Cu-Au) acquired 2020–2021, though these are believed inactive following a strategic pivot to oil and gas in 2022–2023.

name: West Mining Corp.
description: West Mining Corp. is a British Columbia-focused gold and copper exploration company. Its flagship Kena Project (Nelson Mining Division, SE BC) hosts a NI 43-101 resource of 561,900 oz Au Indicated and 2,773,100 oz Au Inferred (Bird 2021), optioned to Upside Gold Corp. in January 2025. The company is actively exploring the Spanish Mountain West and Junker properties in BC. Formerly Ironwood Capital Corp. (renamed November 2020).

name: Westward Gold Inc.
description: Westward Gold Inc. is a junior gold exploration company focused on Carlin-type gold targets in Nevada, USA. Its flagship consolidated land package is the Toiyabe Hills Property (737 claims, ~6,073 ha) on the Cortez Trend in Lander County, and it also holds the Carlin Properties (111 claims) on the northern Carlin Trend in Elko County. All properties are 100%-owned and at the exploration stage with no current NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate.

name: Earthwise Minerals Corp.
description:
Earthwise Minerals Corp. (formerly Hawkmoon Resources Corp., name changed April 2023) is a
    Canadian junior exploration company focused on advancing the Iron Range Gold Project in southeastern
    British Columbia near Creston, BC. The Company holds an option to earn up to an 80% interest in the
    fully permitted Iron Range project, which covers a 10 km × 32 km area along the Iron Range Fault System
    and hosts multiple high-grade gold showings and large-scale geophysical and geochemical anomalies.
    Iron Range is the Company's sole active asset as of early 2026. CEO: Mark Luchinski.
    Also listed: FSE: 966; OTCQB: EWISF (as of March 13, 2026).

name: Westmount Minerals Corp.
description: Westmount Minerals Corp. is a junior mineral exploration company listed on the CSE. Between 2021 and 2025 the Company held option agreements on six early-stage properties in Quebec and Ontario targeting gold and lithium. All six option agreements were terminated or allowed to lapse by September 30, 2025. As of that date the Company holds no active mineral property interests.

name: Western Uranium & Vanadium Corp.
description: Western Uranium & Vanadium Corp. is a Colorado and Utah focused conventional uranium and vanadium producer. Its core asset is the Sunday Mine Complex in San Miguel County, Colorado — a fully permitted, conventional underground uranium-vanadium operation in the Uravan Mineral Belt. The company also holds the San Rafael Uranium Project in Utah (its planned second production centre), the Sage Mine, Dunn Project, Van 4 Mine, Hansen/Taylor Ranch Project, and a 50% interest in the Rimrock Exploration & Development JV. Processing infrastructure is being developed through the Mustang Mineral Processing Site (former Pinon Ridge mill site) in Montrose County and the Maverick Minerals Processing Site near Green River, Utah.

name: Xcite Uranium Inc.
description: Xcite Uranium Inc. (formerly Xcite Resources Inc.) is a Canadian uranium exploration company focused on the Uranium City area of northern Saskatchewan. The company holds 80% earn-in options on six uranium properties totalling ~5,905 ha from Eagle Plains Resources Ltd. (TSX-V: EPL), plus 100% ownership of the Turgeon Lake Gold property in Quebec. All Saskatchewan uranium properties are in the historic Beaverlodge uranium camp and are at the early exploration stage.

name: Yukon Metals Corp.
description: Yukon Metals Corp. is a junior explorer holding a 17-project, >43,000 ha portfolio of 100%-owned properties in Yukon, Canada, covering copper-gold porphyry/skarn, VMS base metals, tungsten skarn, orogenic gold vein, and CRD/manto-style targets. The portfolio was assembled primarily through the May 2024 acquisition of Lapie Mining Inc. from 18526 Yukon Inc., supplemented by post-acquisition staking campaigns. Flagship active projects include AZ (Cu-Au porphyry/skarn), Birch (Cu-Au porphyry/skarn), and Star River (Zn-Pb-Ag-Au CRD/VMS).

name: Zeus North America Mining Corp.
description: Zeus North America Mining Corp. (CSE: ZEUS | OTCQB: ZUUZF | FRA: O92) is a junior exploration company focused on critical mineral discovery in the western United States. Formerly Umdoni Exploration Inc., the company rebranded in February 2024 following the acquisition of three Idaho mineral properties (Cuddy Mountain, Selway, Great Western) from 1273180 B.C. Ltd. The flagship Cuddy Mountain property targets a copper-molybdenum-silver porphyry system adjacent to Hercules Metals Corp.'s Leviathan discovery in Washington County, Idaho. In June 2025, Zeus signed a binding LOI to option two Nevada copper-gold properties (Delker and Bulls Eye). The Chlore porphyry Cu-Mo property in British Columbia was spun out to Kelso Mining Inc. in February 2025.

name: Stardust Metal Corp.
description: Stardust Metal Corp. (formerly Mistango River Resources Inc.; name changed 20-Nov-2025) is a gold and copper exploration company focused on properties in Ontario and Quebec, Canada. The company holds a portfolio of six projects spanning the prolific Kirkland Lake / Cadillac–Larder Lake Break (Abitibi Greenstone Belt) and the Shebandowan Greenstone Belt near Thunder Bay. Key assets include the Omega Mine Project (100% owned, historical NI 43-101 resource), the Kirkland West Project (100% owned, contiguous with Agnico Eagle's Macassa Mine), and the newly optioned McGarry Project (earn-in up to 75% from related company Orecap Invest Corp.). The company also holds a ~15% equity interest in Metal Energy Corp. (TSXV: MERG), owner of the Manibridge Nickel Mine in Manitoba. Related company Orecap Invest Corp. (TSXV: OCI) is a major shareholder; Stephen Stewart serves as Chair of both companies.
